ministry: Ministry of Earth Sciences
benefits: Fellowship of ₹31,000–₹35,000/month plus HRA for PhD research in oceanography, meteorology, seismology and climate science.
eligibility_summary: Young scientists pursuing PhD or postdoctoral research in earth and atmospheric sciences.

title: National Scholarship Portal (NSP) – Central Schemes
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Single portal for 50+ scholarship schemes. Amount varies: ₹1,000–₹20,000/year for school level; ₹10,000–₹1,20,000/year for college/university level.
eligibility_summary: Students from pre-matric to postgraduate level meeting specific income/merit/category criteria.

title: PM eVIDYA – Digital Education Platform
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Free access to 200+ SWAYAM courses, one-class-one-channel DTH TV, DIKSHA digital content and e-books via the NDEAR platform.
eligibility_summary: All school and college students across India.

title: National Education Fellowship Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹31,000 (JRF) to ₹35,000 (SRF) plus HRA and research contingency for PhD scholars in universities.
eligibility_summary: Candidates qualifying UGC-NET/JRF examination.

title: Samagra Shiksha Abhiyan
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Free uniforms (2/year), textbooks, mid-day meals, and ICT labs for government school students. Teacher training and school infrastructure upgradation.
eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in government and government-aided schools from pre-primary to Class 12.

title: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Free residential school education for ST students with modern facilities including sports, cultural activities and ICT. ₹1.38 lakh per student per year covered by Govt.
eligibility_summary: ST students from tribal areas where ST population is 50%+ of the block.

title: Digital Saksharta Abhiyan (DISHA)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Free digital literacy training to 52.5 lakh rural household members. Course covers internet, email, government services, digital payments.
eligibility_summary: Economically weaker sections in rural and semi-urban areas who are not digitally literate.

title: BharatNet Broadband Programme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: High-speed broadband connectivity to all 2.5 lakh Gram Panchayats. Free Wi-Fi hotspots at gram panchayat offices and public places.
eligibility_summary: Residents of villages connected under BharatNet. Businesses and individuals in rural areas.

title: NASSCOM FutureSkills PRIME
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Subsidized and free courses in AI, ML, Cloud, Cybersecurity, AR/VR for IT professionals and students. Certification recognized by industry.
eligibility_summary: IT professionals, fresh graduates and students looking to upskill in emerging technologies.

title: National Clean Air Programme (NCAP)
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
benefits: Pollution reduction targets for 132 non-attainment cities. Grants for dust control, EV fleet, industrial monitoring and citizen awareness.
eligibility_summary: Residents of 132 NCAP cities. Industries and municipal bodies for compliance support.

title: Compensatory Afforestation Fund Management (CAMPA)
ministry: Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
benefits: Employment generation for tribal communities through plantation, protection and forest management activities. Wages and skill development for forest workers.
eligibility_summary: Tribal and forest-dwelling communities residing in/near forest areas.

title: Indian Community Welfare Fund (ICWF)
ministry: Ministry of External Affairs
benefits: Emergency financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for distressed Indian workers abroad. Covers emergency medical, legal aid, food, shelter and repatriation.
eligibility_summary: Indian workers in distress in foreign countries, particularly unskilled and semi-skilled workers.

title: Scholarship Programme for Diaspora Children (SPDC)
ministry: Ministry of External Affairs
benefits: 100 scholarships/year for children of PIO/NRI for undergraduate programmes at Indian universities. Covers tuition fees and hostel charges.
eligibility_summary: Children of PIO/NRI cardholders seeking admission to undergraduate courses in India.

title: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: Collateral-free loans: Shishu (up to ₹50K), Kishor (₹50K–₹5L), Tarun (₹5L–₹10L) at low interest rates for non-corporate small businesses.
eligibility_summary: Non-farm income-generating activities with credit needs up to ₹10 lakh. No collateral required.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: Accidental death and disability insurance cover of ₹2 lakh for death/full disability, ₹1 lakh for partial disability at just ₹20/year premium.
eligibility_summary: Bank account holders aged 18–70 years.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: Subsidy of 40–60% for fishermen (higher for SC/ST/women) on new boats, equipment, ponds, cold storage and processing units.
eligibility_summary: Fishermen, fish farmers, SHGs, cooperatives and fish processing units.

title: Kisan Credit Card for Fisheries & Animal Husbandry
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: Short-term working capital credit up to ₹2 lakh at subsidized interest rate for fish farming and animal husbandry activities.
eligibility_summary: Individual fishers, fish farmers and animal husbandry practitioners.

title: National Livestock Mission (NLM)
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: 50% subsidy for backward/forward linkages in livestock sector. Support for fodder development, breed improvement and insurance for animals.
eligibility_summary: Individual farmers, SHGs and FPOs engaged in livestock rearing.

title: PM Formalisation of Micro Food Processing (PM-FME)
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
benefits: 35% credit-linked subsidy (max ₹10 lakh) for micro food processing units. Branding support, technical assistance and skilling for 2 lakh units.
eligibility_summary: Existing micro food processing units, SHGs, cooperatives and FPOs.

title: PLI Scheme for Food Processing Industry
ministry: Ministry of Food Processing Industries
benefits: Production Linked Incentive of 4–10% for 6 years on incremental sales for processed food manufacturers investing ₹10 crore or more.
eligibility_summary: Food processing companies with minimum investment of ₹10 crore for innovative/organic products.

title: FAME India Phase II – Faster Adoption of EVs
ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries
benefits: Demand incentives of ₹10,000 (e-2W) to ₹5 lakh (e-bus) on purchase of electric vehicles. Interest subvention on EV loans for 2-wheelers.
eligibility_summary: Individuals purchasing electric two-wheelers, three-wheelers and commercial EVs.

title: PLI Scheme for Automobiles and Auto Components
ministry: Ministry of Heavy Industries
benefits: Incentive of 8–18% on incremental sales of Advanced Automotive Technology (AAT) products over 5 years for eligible manufacturers.
eligibility_summary: Automobile OEMs and component manufacturers with minimum investment commitments.

title: Prasar Bharati Internship Programme
ministry: Ministry of Information and Broadcasting
benefits: Paid internship at Doordarshan and All India Radio. Stipend of ₹5,000–₹10,000/month. Hands-on media production experience.
eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in media, journalism, mass communication or film courses.

title: Jal Jeevan Mission – Har Ghar Jal
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
benefits: Functional Household Tap Connections (FHTC) to every rural household by 2024. Each connection provides 55 litres/person/day of clean drinking water.
eligibility_summary: All rural households in India without piped drinking water supply.

title: Swachh Bharat Mission (Grameen) Phase II – ODF+
ministry: Ministry of Jal Shakti
benefits: Financial incentive of ₹12,000 per toilet construction for BPL households. Solid/liquid waste management infrastructure at village level.
eligibility_summary: BPL households in rural areas without sanitation facilities.

title: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: Guaranteed monthly pension of ₹3,000 from age 60 for unorganized sector workers. Government matches employee contribution.
eligibility_summary: Unorganised workers aged 18–40 with monthly income up to ₹15,000.

title: Pradhan Mantri Rojgar Protsahan Yojana (PMRPY)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: Government pays full employer EPF contribution (12%) for 3 years for new employees with salary up to ₹15,000/month added by EPFO-registered employers.
eligibility_summary: EPFO-registered establishments hiring new employees with salary up to ₹15,000.

title: Employees' State Insurance (ESI) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: Comprehensive medical care for worker and family, sickness cash benefit at 70% of wages for 91 days, maternity benefit for 26 weeks, disability pension.
eligibility_summary: Employees in establishments covered under ESI Act with wages up to ₹21,000/month.

title: Tele-Law Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Law and Justice
benefits: Free legal advice via video conference at Common Service Centres for marginalized communities. Access to 1 lakh+ CSCs and trained Para Legal Volunteers.
eligibility_summary: Marginalized citizens including SC, ST, women, workers, minorities needing legal advice.

title: NALSA Legal Services to Victims of Trafficking
ministry: Ministry of Law and Justice
benefits: Free legal representation, compensation claims and rehabilitation support for victims of human trafficking through State Legal Services Authorities.
eligibility_summary: Victims of human trafficking, particularly women and children.

title: District Mineral Foundation (DMF) – PMKKKY Welfare
ministry: Ministry of Mines
benefits: Welfare schemes for mining-affected communities — drinking water, healthcare, education, skill development and livelihood support funded by DMF.
eligibility_summary: People directly or indirectly affected by mining operations in mining districts.

title: Pre-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹1,000 (Day Scholar) to ₹13,500 (Hosteller) for Class 1–10 students from minority communities.
eligibility_summary: Students from Muslim, Christian, Sikh, Buddhist, Zoroastrian and Jain communities with family income below ₹1 lakh.

title: Post-Matric Scholarship for Minorities
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Course fee (full) + maintenance allowance of ₹3,000–₹10,000/year for students from minority communities in Class 11 to PhD level.
eligibility_summary: Students from notified minority communities with family income below ₹2 lakh/year.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK)
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Construction of schools, colleges, ITIs, skill development centres, hospitals and drinking water facilities in identified Minority Concentration Districts.
eligibility_summary: Residents of 308 Minority Concentration Districts across India.

title: PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: Up to 300 units free electricity/month via rooftop solar. Subsidy of ₹30,000–₹78,000 for 1–3 kW systems. Additional benefits for tribal and BPL families.
eligibility_summary: Residential households installing rooftop solar panels (up to 3 kW for full subsidy).

title: PM KUSUM – Kisan Urja Suraksha evam Utthaan Mahabhiyan
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
benefits: 60% subsidy on solar pumps (Component B) for farmers. Solar power plants on barren agricultural land with ₹60,000/year income per 2 hectares (Component A).
eligibility_summary: Farmers for solar pump installation and land owners in rural areas for solar plants.

title: Rashtriya Gram Swaraj Abhiyan (RGSA)
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
benefits: Training and capacity building for elected Panchayat representatives. Technology support, e-Gram Swaraj platform and performance-based grants.
eligibility_summary: Elected Panchayat representatives, officials and SHG members in rural governance.

title: Svamitva Scheme – Property Rights for Rural Households
ministry: Ministry of Panchayati Raj
benefits: Survey of inhabited rural land and distribution of legal property cards. Enables villagers to use property as collateral for institutional loans.
eligibility_summary: Rural household owners in villages mapped under the SVAMITVA scheme.

title: Central Government Health Scheme (CGHS)
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
benefits: Comprehensive medical care for Central Govt employees and pensioners at CGHS wellness centres and empanelled hospitals. Subsidized medicines.
eligibility_summary: Central Government employees, pensioners and their dependent family members in CGHS-covered cities.

title: National Pension System (NPS) – Government Sector
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
benefits: Market-linked retirement savings with government contributing 14% of basic pay. Tax deduction under Section 80CCD(1) and 80CCD(2). Portable across jobs.
eligibility_summary: Central Government employees (mandatory) and voluntary subscribers aged 18–70.

title: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY) 2.0
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Free LPG connection with first cylinder refill and stove/hotplate for BPL women. Migrant families get connection without address proof.
eligibility_summary: Women from BPL households, SC/ST communities, forest dwellers and tea garden workers.

title: LPG Subsidy – DBT Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefits: Direct subsidy transfer to bank accounts for domestic LPG cylinder consumption. PAHAL scheme ensures transparent subsidy delivery.
eligibility_summary: Domestic LPG consumers with Aadhaar-linked bank accounts.

title: Sagarmala Programme – Port-Led Development
ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
benefits: Over 800 projects worth ₹5.5 lakh crore for port modernisation, coastal connectivity and fishing harbour development. Skill development for 4 lakh coastal community youth.
eligibility_summary: Coastal communities, fishermen and businesses near port areas benefiting from infrastructure.

title: LADIS – Lighthouse Tourism Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
benefits: Conversion of 71 lighthouses into tourist destinations with hotels, museums and adventure activities. Employment for local coastal communities.
eligibility_summary: Tourists visiting lighthouse destinations and local entrepreneurs near lighthouse areas.

title: Viklangjan Concession – Railway Concession for Disabled
ministry: Ministry of Railways
benefits: 75% concession on railway fare for persons with benchmark disabilities in all classes. Companion also gets 50% concession.
eligibility_summary: Persons with benchmark disabilities holding valid disability certificate.

title: PM Gram Sadak Yojana (PMGSY) Phase III
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways
benefits: All-weather road connectivity to unconnected habitations (500+ population in plains; 250+ in hills/tribal areas). Improves access to markets, schools and hospitals.
eligibility_summary: Residents of rural habitations receiving new all-weather road connectivity.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
benefits: ₹1.20 lakh in plains and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly/difficult/IAP areas for construction of 2.95 crore pucca houses. 90–95 days MGNREGS wages for labour.
eligibility_summary: Houseless and kutcha/severely damaged house dwellers in rural areas.

title: Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana – NRLM (DAY-NRLM)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
benefits: Interest subvention of 5.5–7% on loans for Women's SHGs. Revolving fund of ₹15,000 and community investment fund up to ₹2.5 lakh per SHG.
eligibility_summary: Women from poor rural households willing to join Self-Help Groups.

title: INSPIRE Scholarship for Higher Education (SHE)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: ₹80,000/year scholarship for 5 years for students pursuing BSc/BS/Int MSc in Natural and Basic Sciences. Research attachment and mentorship.
eligibility_summary: Students ranking in top 1% in Class XII boards pursuing science at BSc/BS level.

title: DST WISE-KIRAN – Women Scientists Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Fellowship of ₹55,000–₹75,000/month for women scientists with career gap. Research grants up to ₹20 lakh for independent research.
eligibility_summary: Women scientists who have taken a career break and wish to return to R&D.

title: Atal Innovation Mission (AIM) – Tinkering Labs
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: ₹20 lakh grant for setting up Atal Tinkering Labs in schools with tools for robotics, 3D printing and electronics. Annual grants of ₹10 lakh for operations.
eligibility_summary: Schools (Govt, Private, CBSE/ICSE/State board) in India to set up innovation labs for students Class 6–12.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 4.0 (PMKVY)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Free skill training and certification in 300+ job roles. Post-training placement assistance. ₹8,000–₹10,000 reward for successful candidates.
eligibility_summary: Indian nationals aged 15–45 seeking employment-oriented skill training.

title: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) – Non-Formal Skill Training
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Short-term vocational training programmes at ₹1,500–₹4,000 total course fee. Priority to women, SC, ST and neo-literate learners.
eligibility_summary: Neo-literates, non-literates and school dropouts in the 15–45 age group.

title: PM-DAKSH – Skill Development for SC/OBC
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free upskilling/reskilling for SC, OBC, EBC and sanitation workers. Stipend of ₹1,000–₹1,500/month during training plus post-training assistance.
eligibility_summary: SC, OBC, EBC and Safai Karamchari communities seeking skill development.

title: Dr. Ambedkar Medical Aid Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Medical aid up to ₹50,000 for SC persons with annual income below ₹3 lakh for critical surgeries not covered by government health schemes.
eligibility_summary: SC persons with annual family income below ₹3 lakh requiring critical medical treatment.

title: National Scholarship for Persons with Disability
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Scholarship of ₹3,500 (Class 1–5) to ₹25,000/year (postgraduate) for students with benchmark disabilities from Class 1 to postgraduate level.
eligibility_summary: Students with at least 40% disability pursuing education from Class 1 to postgraduate level.

title: NSSO Socio-Economic Surveys – Data for Policy
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
benefits: Participation in nationally representative surveys. Field investigators and supervisors get employment. Survey data available free for academic research.
eligibility_summary: Researchers and academics for data access; field staff for survey employment opportunities.

title: MP Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS)
ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation
benefits: MPs can recommend works of ₹5 crore per year in their constituency for durable community assets like schools, hospitals, roads and water facilities.
eligibility_summary: Residents of any Parliamentary constituency — works nominated by local MP.

title: PLI Scheme for Specialty Steel
ministry: Ministry of Steel
benefits: Incentive of 4–12% on incremental production of specialty steel over 5 years for domestic steel producers.
eligibility_summary: Steel producers investing in specialty steel capacity in India.

title: National Steel Policy 2017 Reforms
ministry: Ministry of Steel
benefits: Target 300 MT steel production by 2030-31. Rationalized import duties, promotion of domestic manufacturing and export of value-added steel products.
eligibility_summary: Steel manufacturers, investors and downstream industries in the steel value chain.

title: PM MITRA – Mega Integrated Textile Region and Apparel Parks
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: ₹4,445 crore for 7 PM MITRA parks with world-class plug-and-play infrastructure. 21 lakh direct and indirect jobs. Competitive incentives for investors.
eligibility_summary: Textile and apparel manufacturers looking to set up or expand operations.

title: Samarth – Scheme for Capacity Building in Textiles Sector
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Free skill training for 10 lakh persons in organised and traditional textile sectors. Placement assistance and stipend during training.
eligibility_summary: Youth and women seeking employment in the textile and apparel sector.

title: National Handloom Development Programme (NHDP)
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Financial assistance for weavers: subsidized yarn, design development, marketing exposure at national exhibitions, tool kits and cluster development.
eligibility_summary: Handloom weavers, master weavers and weaver cooperatives.

title: PRASHAD – Pilgrimage Rejuvenation and Spiritual Heritage Augmentation Drive
ministry: Ministry of Tourism
benefits: Development of 25+ pilgrimage destinations with better roads, parking, lighting, sanitation and visitor amenities. Employment for local tourism workers.
eligibility_summary: Tourists visiting PRASHAD-developed pilgrimage sites. Local service providers and guides.

title: SWADESH DARSHAN 2.0 – Eco & Wellness Tourism
ministry: Ministry of Tourism
benefits: Development of eco, wellness and tribal tourism circuits. Homestay promotion, skill training for local guides and service providers.
eligibility_summary: Local communities, homestay owners and tourism entrepreneurs in identified circuits.

title: Eklavya Model Residential Schools (EMRS) – Tribal Education
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Free residential school education with boarding for ST children with sports, cultural and ICT facilities. ₹1.38 lakh per student per year.
eligibility_summary: Scheduled Tribe students in blocks with 50%+ ST population, Class 6–12.

title: Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVK) – Tribal Livelihood
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Primary processing of Minor Forest Produce at cluster level. ₹15 lakh grant per cluster of 15 SHGs (300 tribal members). Skill training and marketing support.
eligibility_summary: Tribal community members involved in collection of Minor Forest Produce.

title: Scholarship for Scheduled Tribe Students – Pre & Post-Matric
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Pre-matric: ₹150–₹350/month + annual allowance. Post-matric: Full maintenance, tuition and non-refundable charges for ST students in Class 11 to PhD.
eligibility_summary: Scheduled Tribe students studying from Class 9 onwards with family income below ₹2.5 lakh.

title: Mission Shakti – Sambal & Samarthya for Women
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: One-Stop Centres at district level for women victims of violence — medical, legal, psychological aid and shelter under one roof. Safety and helpline services (181).
eligibility_summary: Women facing any form of violence — domestic, trafficking, acid attack, etc.

title: Khelo India Youth Games
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Annual scholarship of ₹5 lakh for 8 years for talented athletes selected at Khelo India Games. Access to top coaching, equipment and sporting infrastructure.
eligibility_summary: Student athletes under 18 years competing in Khelo India School Games or University Games.

title: Target Olympic Podium Scheme (TOPS)
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Monthly out-of-pocket allowance of ₹50,000. Customized training abroad, international competition exposure, equipment, sports science and medical support.
eligibility_summary: Elite athletes with realistic potential to win medals at the next Olympics/Paralympics.

title: National Youth Corps (NYC)
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Monthly honorarium of ₹5,000 for youth volunteers engaged in community service in rural areas. Certificate of service for future employment.
eligibility_summary: Youth aged 18–25 years willing to serve in rural areas for 1 year.

title: Aspirational Districts Programme
ministry: NITI Aayog (National Institution for Transforming India)
benefits: Focused development across 112 most backward districts in health, nutrition, education, agriculture, financial inclusion and infrastructure. Real-time monitoring.
eligibility_summary: Residents of 112 Aspirational Districts across 28 states in India.

title: Lokpal Complaint Portal
ministry: The Lokpal of India
benefits: Free online/offline complaint mechanism against corruption by Group A, B, C, D Central Government employees. Status tracking and protection for complainants.
eligibility_summary: Any person having knowledge of or being affected by corruption by a public servant.

title: PM Scholarship Scheme for Central Armed Police Forces (CAPF)
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
benefits: ₹2,500/month (boys) and ₹3,000/month (girls) for wards and widows of CAPF/Assam Rifles personnel for professional courses.
eligibility_summary: Children/widows of CAPF and Assam Rifles personnel who died in action or are disabled.

title: Modernisation of Police Forces (MPF) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
benefits: Central assistance for police force modernisation: equipment, training, forensics, police housing and CCTNS digital connectivity.
eligibility_summary: State governments and UT administrations implementing police modernisation projects.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
benefits: Credit-linked subsidy of 3–6.5% on home loans: EWS/LIG (6.5%, max ₹2.67 lakh), MIG-I (4%, max ₹2.35 lakh), MIG-II (3%, max ₹2.30 lakh).
eligibility_summary: Urban households earning up to ₹18 lakh/year who do not own a pucca house.

title: AMRUT 2.0 – Atal Mission for Urban Transformation
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs
benefits: Universal household water supply and sewerage/septage management in 500 cities. Development of green spaces and parks for urban residents.
eligibility_summary: Residents of 500 AMRUT cities for improved water, sanitation and urban amenities.

title: National Food Security Mission (NFSM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Seed subsidies, demonstration plots, farm machinery, IPM kits and training for farmers to boost production of rice, wheat, pulses, coarse cereals and commercial crops.
eligibility_summary: Farmers in identified low-productivity districts for rice, wheat, pulses and oilseeds.

title: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY-RAFTAAR)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Grant funding up to ₹25 lakh for agri-startups; skilling of 75,000 agripreneurs; innovation grants for value-chain projects.
eligibility_summary: Farmers, agri-entrepreneurs, FPOs and agri-startups across all states.

title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Subsidy of 55–80% on drip and sprinkler irrigation systems. 'Har Khet Ko Pani' ensures water access; 'More Crop Per Drop' promotes water-use efficiency.
eligibility_summary: All farmers with landholding looking to adopt micro-irrigation systems.

title: eNAM – National Agriculture Market
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Online trading platform linking 1,000+ APMCs. Farmers get transparent price discovery, better market access and direct payment to bank account.
eligibility_summary: Farmers with produce registered at eNAM-connected mandis.

title: Formation and Promotion of FPOs (Farmer Producer Organizations)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Equity grant up to ₹15 lakh per FPO, ₹25 lakh credit guarantee fund, handholding support for 5 years. 10,000 FPOs to be formed.
eligibility_summary: Minimum 300 farmer members to form and register an FPO.

title: PM Annadata Aay SanraksHan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Price Deficiency Payment Scheme — if market price falls below MSP, government pays the difference directly to farmer's bank account for oilseeds & pulses.
eligibility_summary: Farmers growing oilseeds, pulses and copra in states implementing PM-AASHA.

title: Integrated Scheme on Agriculture Marketing (ISAM)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Financial assistance for grading/sorting units, warehousing, cold chain and market infrastructure. Integration of rural and urban markets.
eligibility_summary: Agricultural cooperatives, FPOs and state agencies building market infrastructure.

title: National Mission on Sustainable Agriculture (NMSA)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Soil Health Cards, micro-irrigation subsidies, organic farming support and water conservation practices. ₹2,000 soil health card incentive per farmer.
eligibility_summary: All farmers, especially in rain-fed areas, to improve soil health and farm sustainability.

title: Gramin Bhandaran Yojana – Rural Godown Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: Capital subsidy of 25% (33.33% for SC/ST/cooperatives) for construction of rural godowns. Allows farmers to avoid distress sale by storing produce.
eligibility_summary: Individual farmers, SHGs, FPOs and cooperatives constructing warehouses in rural areas.

title: PM Kisan Maan Dhan Yojana – Pension for Farmers
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: ₹3,000/month guaranteed pension at age 60 for small and marginal farmers. Government matches farmer's contribution of ₹55–₹200/month.
eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers aged 18–40 years with cultivable land up to 2 hectares.

title: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefits: ₹1 lakh crore fund offering loans at 3% interest subvention for 7 years for post-harvest infra — cold storage, processing units, silos, assaying labs.
eligibility_summary: Farmers, FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs and cooperatives investing in post-harvest infrastructure.

title: AYUSH Health & Wellness Centre Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Ayush
benefits: Free yoga, naturopathy and AYUSH consultations at 12,500+ Health & Wellness Centres. Home remedies guidance and preventive health camps.
eligibility_summary: All citizens seeking preventive healthcare and wellness services at PHC-level centres.

title: AYUSH Startup Challenge & Innovation Grand
ministry: Ministry of Ayush
benefits: Grants of ₹25 lakh to ₹1 crore for AYUSH product startups and innovators. Incubation support at AIIA and CCRAS institutions.
eligibility_summary: Startups and entrepreneurs working on AYUSH-based health products and innovations.

title: National AYUSH Mission – Infrastructure Development
ministry: Ministry of Ayush
benefits: Central assistance for upgradation of state AYUSH hospitals and dispensaries. New AYUSH colleges and upgradation of existing ones to improve quality.
eligibility_summary: State governments and AYUSH institutions for infrastructure grants.

title: Ministry of Ayush – COVID Management Protocol
ministry: Ministry of Ayush
benefits: Free distribution of AYUSH immunity boosting kit (Ashwagandha, Guduchi etc.) and protocol guidelines for COVID prevention and management.
eligibility_summary: All citizens seeking AYUSH-based preventive care and immunity support.

title: Global Innovation Index – India Ranking Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefits: Support for innovation ecosystem — IP protection funding, patent facilitation and innovation grants to improve India's global innovation ranking.
eligibility_summary: Innovators, startups, R&D institutions and universities filing patents and innovations.

title: DPIIT – Angel Tax Exemption for Startups
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefits: 100% exemption from Angel Tax (Section 56(2)(viib)) for DPIIT-recognized startups on funds received. Boosts early-stage investment.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT-recognized startups receiving investment from angel investors.

title: GEM – Government e-Marketplace for MSMEs
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefits: Free seller registration for MSMEs and startups on GeM portal. Access to ₹1 lakh+ crore in government procurement annually without tender complexity.
eligibility_summary: MSMEs, startups and self-employed artisans offering goods/services to government.

title: Scheme for Startups Intellectual Property Protection (SIPP)
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefits: Reimbursement of 80% of facilitation cost for filing patents, trademarks and designs. ₹15,000 for Indian patent; ₹3 lakh for international patent filing.
eligibility_summary: DPIIT-recognized startups applying for intellectual property rights.

title: District Level Incubation and Accelerator Programme (DIAP)
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry
benefits: District-level startup incubation support with mentorship, seed funding up to ₹10 lakh and co-working space for first-time entrepreneurs.
eligibility_summary: Aspiring entrepreneurs and early-stage startups in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities.

title: India Post Payments Bank (IPPB) – Basic Savings Account
ministry: Ministry of Communication
benefits: Zero-balance savings account, doorstep banking through 3+ lakh postmen, free UPI, QR transfers and DBT receipt facility at every doorstep.
eligibility_summary: Any citizen including rural, elderly and migrant workers without access to regular banks.

title: Post Office Monthly Income Scheme (POMIS)
ministry: Ministry of Communication
benefits: Fixed monthly income at 7.4% interest p.a. on lump-sum deposit of up to ₹9 lakh (single) / ₹15 lakh (joint). No TDS if income below taxable limit.
eligibility_summary: Any resident Indian, individually or jointly, looking for regular monthly income.

title: Senior Citizen Savings Scheme (SCSS) via Post Office
ministry: Ministry of Communication
benefits: 8.2% interest per annum (quarterly payout), deposit up to ₹30 lakh. Tax benefit under Section 80C. Available at all post offices.
eligibility_summary: Retired individuals aged 60+ years (55+ for government retirees on superannuation).

title: Kisan VIKAS Patra (KVP) – Post Office Savings
ministry: Ministry of Communication
benefits: Investment doubles in 115 months at 7.5% interest compounded annually. No maximum investment limit. Premature encashment after 2.5 years.
eligibility_summary: Any adult resident Indian or minor through guardian at any post office.

title: National Savings Certificate (NSC) – Post Office
ministry: Ministry of Communication
benefits: 7.7% interest compounded annually but paid at maturity. ₹100 minimum investment. Tax benefit under Section 80C up to ₹1.5 lakh.
eligibility_summary: Any adult resident Indian investing in NSC at post offices for tax-efficient fixed returns.

title: PM POSHAN – Mid Day Meal Scheme (New Name)
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Free hot cooked meal to 11.8 crore children in Class 1–8 in government schools. 450 calories and 12g protein for primary, 700 calories for upper primary.
eligibility_summary: All students enrolled in government and government-aided schools up to Class 8.

title: Right to Education (RTE) – Free & Compulsory Education
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Free and compulsory education for all children aged 6–14 years. 25% reservation for EWS students in private schools with government reimbursement.
eligibility_summary: All children aged 6–14 years, especially those from EWS and disadvantaged groups.

title: SWAYAM – Study Webs of Active Learning for Young Aspiring Minds
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: 1,900+ free online courses from IITs, IIMs and top universities. Credit transfer allowed. Verified certificates for small fee.
eligibility_summary: Any student or working professional seeking quality online education.

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMS)
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹12,000/year scholarship for meritorious students from Class 9 to Class 12 studying in government schools.
eligibility_summary: State-Board students studying in government schools passing Class 8 with 55%+ marks and family income below ₹3.5 lakh.

title: National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) Scholarship
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹1,250/month for Class 11–12, ₹2,000/month for UG/PG and PhD level for top 1,000 selected students. Continues up to PhD.
eligibility_summary: Class 10 students in India appearing in the NTSE examination conducted by NCERT.

title: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV) – Free Residential School
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Completely free residential education (Classes 6–12) including food, accommodation, uniforms and books for rural meritorious students at 649 Navodaya schools.
eligibility_summary: Rural children studying in Class 5 applying through JNVST for Class 6 admission.

title: Fee Waiver for SC/ST at IITs and Central Universities
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: Complete tuition fee waiver for SC/ST students at all IITs, NITs and Central Universities. Additional free hostel facility and book grants.
eligibility_summary: SC/ST students admitted to IITs, NITs and Central Universities.

title: PM Special Scholarship Scheme for J&K and Ladakh Students
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: 5,000 scholarships for J&K and Ladakh students for professional/technical courses in institutions outside J&K. ₹30,000/year tuition + ₹1 lakh/year maintenance.
eligibility_summary: Domicile students of J&K and Ladakh pursuing professional courses outside J&K.

title: CBSE Single Girl Child Merit Scholarship
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹500/month for Class 11 and 12 for single girl child of her parents studying in CBSE affiliated schools with 60%+ in Class 10.
eligibility_summary: Single girl child of parents studying in CBSE-affiliated schools scoring 60%+ in CBSE Class 10.

title: PM-USHA – PM Uttam Shiksha Abhiyaan (Higher Ed)
ministry: Ministry of Education
benefits: ₹40,000 crore over 5 years for state universities — research grants, digital classrooms, women hostels, laboratory upgradation and skilling centres.
eligibility_summary: Students at state government universities in beneficiary states.

title: Digital India Internship Scheme (DIIS)
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Stipend of ₹10,000/month for 2-month internship in MeitY, NIC and digital infrastructure agencies for BTech/MCA/BCA students.
eligibility_summary: Final year B.Tech/BCA/MCA students from AICTE-approved colleges.

title: Chips to Startup (C2S) Programme
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Stipend of ₹12,000–₹24,000/month for training in VLSI and chip design. Scholarships for 85,000 engineers in semiconductor technologies.
eligibility_summary: Engineering students and professionals in ECE/CS pursuing semiconductor and chip design courses.

title: National Supercomputing Mission (NSM) – Research Access
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Free access to 70+ petaflop HPC infrastructure for academic research, climate modelling, drug discovery, AI/ML at Param Siddhi and other supercomputers.
eligibility_summary: Researchers, PhD scholars and faculty at Indian universities and R&D institutions.

title: UMANG – Unified Mobile Application for New-age Governance
ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
benefits: Single app providing access to 2,000+ government services including EPF, Aadhaar, DigiLocker, income tax, passport, scholarships — 24/7 on mobile.
eligibility_summary: All citizens with a smartphone seeking easy access to government services.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: ₹2 lakh life insurance cover for death (any cause) at just ₹436/year premium. Auto-debit from bank account annually.
eligibility_summary: Bank account holders aged 18–50 years.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000–₹5,000/month at age 60. Government co-contribution of 50% (max ₹1,000/year) for eligible subscribers for 5 years.
eligibility_summary: Citizens aged 18–40 years with a savings bank account, not covered by statutory social security.

title: PM SVANidhi – Street Vendor Loan Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: Working capital loan of ₹10,000 (1st) → ₹20,000 (2nd) → ₹50,000 (3rd) for street vendors. 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment.
eligibility_summary: Street vendors operating in urban areas with a Certificate of Vending or Letter of Recommendation.

title: Stand Up India Scheme – SC/ST/Women Entrepreneurs
ministry: Ministry of Finance
benefits: Bank loan of ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for greenfield enterprises in manufacturing, trading or services. At least one SC/ST and one woman borrower per bank branch.
eligibility_summary: SC/ST entrepreneurs and women above 18 years for setting up new enterprises.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY / Ayushman Bharat)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: ₹5 lakh/year health cover per family for secondary and tertiary care at 28,000+ empanelled hospitals. Cashless and paperless treatment.
eligibility_summary: Bottom 40% of Indian population as per SECC 2011 — approx. 55 crore beneficiaries.

title: National Rural Health Mission (NHM) – Free Healthcare
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free OPD consultations, medicines and diagnostics at PHCs/CHCs. ASHAs provide doorstep healthcare linkage. Janani Suraksha Yojana cash incentive.
eligibility_summary: All rural citizens, especially pregnant women, children under 5 and those with communicable diseases.

title: Janani Suraksha Yojana (JSY) – Safe Motherhood
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cash incentive of ₹1,400 (rural) and ₹1,000 (urban) for BPL pregnant women delivering at government hospitals. ASHA gets ₹600 per delivery facilitated.
eligibility_summary: BPL pregnant women of any age delivering at government health institutions.

title: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: ₹5,000 cash benefit in installments for pregnant and lactating women for first live birth. Additional ₹6,000 for second child if girl.
eligibility_summary: Pregnant and lactating women (excluding government employees) for first and second birth.

title: Mission Indradhanush – Universal Immunization
ministry: Ministry of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Free vaccination for 12 vaccine-preventable diseases including Polio, BCG, DPT, Hepatitis B, Measles, Rubella, Pneumococcal and Rotavirus vaccines.
eligibility_summary: All children up to 2 years of age and pregnant women for immunization.

title: Border Area Development Programme (BADP)
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
benefits: Infrastructure development in border areas — schools, roads, water supply, primary health centres, skill centres and border haats for economic integration.
eligibility_summary: Residents of 111 border districts across 17 states in India.

title: PM Rehabilitation Package for Migrants and Widows (J&K)
ministry: Ministry of Home Affairs
benefits: Monthly relief of ₹3,000 (single/widow) and ₹13,000 per family for registered Kashmiri migrants. Free ration and transit accommodation support.
eligibility_summary: Registered Kashmiri migrants and widows displaced from J&K.

title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: 25–35% government subsidy on project cost up to ₹50 lakh (manufacturing) / ₹20 lakh (service). Helps create 8 lakh jobs annually.
eligibility_summary: Individuals above 18 years for setting up new manufacturing/service units. Existing units not eligible.

title: Credit Guarantee Fund Scheme for Micro and Small Enterprises (CGTMSE)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Collateral-free credit up to ₹2 crore for Micro and Small Enterprises. Government provides guarantee cover of 75–85% to lending institutions.
eligibility_summary: Micro and Small Enterprises (both new and existing) seeking term loans/working capital.

title: MSME Cluster Development Programme (CDP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Financial assistance of 70–90% for Common Facility Centres (CFCs) with machinery, testing labs and R&D facilities shared by cluster MSMEs.
eligibility_summary: Groups of MSMEs in identified clusters for setting up common facility infrastructure.

title: Technology Upgradation and Quality Certification Scheme (TEQUP)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: 50% subsidy (max ₹75,000 per year) for acquiring ISO-9000, ISO-14001, HACCP and other quality certifications for MSMEs.
eligibility_summary: Micro and Small Enterprises seeking quality certification for domestic/export markets.

title: ASPIRE – Agro-Industry Incubation Programme
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Setting up 80 livelihood incubators and 20 technology incubators to foster rural entrepreneurship in agro-processing and allied sectors.
eligibility_summary: Rural entrepreneurs and agri-startups seeking incubation support in agro-industry.

title: Udyam Registration – MSME Registration Portal
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefits: Free online MSME registration in minutes. Opens access to priority lending, collateral-free credit, subsidies, government procurement benefits and protection against delayed payments.
eligibility_summary: Any micro, small or medium enterprise (manufacturing or service) in India.

title: DBT BioCare – Women Scientists in Life Sciences
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Fellowship of ₹50,000/month for women scientists returning to mainstream bioscience R&D. Research grant up to ₹10 lakh. Placement assistance.
eligibility_summary: Women bioscientists with career breaks wanting to re-enter research.

title: SERB National Science Fellowship (SERB-NXRF)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹15 lakh/year for top Indian scientists to pursue cutting-edge research of global impact. 30 fellowships per year.
eligibility_summary: Active researchers in natural and engineering sciences with exceptional national/global impact.

title: National Biopharma Mission – Research Grants
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grants for vaccine development, diagnostic kits, biopharmaceuticals and medical devices. Industry-academia partnership grants up to ₹5 crore.
eligibility_summary: Biotech startups, pharma companies and research institutions in life sciences.

title: Vigyan Jyoti Scheme – Girls in STEM
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Stipend of ₹10,000–₹30,000/year, residential camps at prestigious labs, mentoring by women scientists for meritorious girl students in Class 9–12.
eligibility_summary: Meritorious girl students in Class 9–12 from government/government-aided schools.

title: PM Vigyan Pradhanmantri Fellowships for Science
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: ₹70,000–₹80,000/month fellowship for young scientists (under 40) doing research at premier national institutes.
eligibility_summary: Young researchers below 40 years working on cutting-edge science projects.

title: Pradhan Mantri Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMAGY)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Integrated development of SC-majority villages — roads, drinking water, sanitation, electricity, school buildings and anganwadis. ₹21 lakh per village.
eligibility_summary: SC-majority villages (50%+ SC population) with population 1,000–5,000 persons.

title: National Overseas Scholarship for SC/ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Full scholarship for Master's and PhD abroad: visa fees, tuition, living allowance of up to £1,166/month, airfare and contingency allowance. 125 slots/year.
eligibility_summary: SC/ST students below 35 years with Master's degree applying for PhD/Master's abroad.

title: Babu Jagjivan Ram Chhatrawas Yojana – SC Hostel
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Central grants for construction/expansion of hostels for SC students. Covers land, building, furniture, kitchen equipment and maintenance at 100% central share.
eligibility_summary: SC students from Class 9 to postgraduate level needing hostel accommodation.

title: National Safai Karamcharis Finance & Development Corporation (NSKFDC)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Concessional loans at 2–6% for Safai Karamcharis and manual scavengers for housing, education, vocational training and income-generating activities.
eligibility_summary: Safai Karamcharis, scavengers and their dependants belonging to SC communities.

title: Assistance for Skill Development of OBCs and EBCs
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: 100 residential coaching centres for OBC/EBC youth. Free skill training, accommodation and placement support for competitive examinations.
eligibility_summary: OBC and EBC youth seeking skill development and preparation for competitive exams.

title: Atal Vayo Abhyudaya Yojana (AVYAY) – Senior Citizens
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Integrated programme for senior citizens: Rashtriya Vayoshri Yojana (free aids/appliances), SACRED portal for employment, elderly helpline 14567 and care homes.
eligibility_summary: Senior citizens aged 60+ years, especially from BPL households.

title: NIMHANS and UMANG – Mental Health Digital Helpline
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free national mental health helpline iCall (9152987821), tele-counselling, online therapy platform and peer support for mental wellness.
eligibility_summary: Any citizen experiencing mental health challenges — free and confidential.

title: Scheme of Free Coaching for SC and OBC Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
benefits: Free residential coaching for UPSC, SSC, IIT-JEE, NEET, State PSC etc. at empanelled coaching institutes. Stipend of ₹3,000/month during coaching.
eligibility_summary: SC/OBC students with family income below ₹8 lakh/year appearing for competitive exams.

title: Yarn Bank Scheme for Handloom Weavers
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Interest-free yarn credit for handloom weavers, SHGs and cooperatives. Banks get credit guarantee; weavers access yarn without upfront payment.
eligibility_summary: Individual handloom weavers, SHGs and cooperative societies.

title: Handicraft Artisan Credit Card Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Working capital credit up to ₹2 lakh for handicraft artisans at 6% interest for purchase of raw materials and tools.
eligibility_summary: Registered handicraft artisans with valid artisan card.

title: National Handicraft Development Programme (NHDP)
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Ambedkar Hastshilp Vikas Yojana — cluster development, design inputs, skill training, export promotion and marketing support for 70 lakh artisans.
eligibility_summary: Handicraft artisans and craftspersons across India's traditional handicraft clusters.

title: Silk Samagra – Integrated Scheme for Silk Industry
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
benefits: Subsidy for mulberry plantation, equipment for cocoon production, seed subsidy for bivoltine silk, and training for silk weavers.
eligibility_summary: Farmers engaged in sericulture and silk weavers seeking to upgrade quality.

title: National Service Scheme (NSS)
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: ₹400/year NSS allowance + adventure camps, special camps and overseas youth exchange programmes. NSS certificate boosts employability.
eligibility_summary: Students aged 15–25 enrolled in schools and colleges across India.

title: Pandit Deendayal Upadhyay National Welfare Fund for Sportspersons
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: One-time financial assistance of ₹5–₹10 lakh and monthly pension of ₹15,000–₹25,000 for past medallists at international competitions facing hardship.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens who won medals at Olympics, Commonwealth, Asian Games or World Championships and are facing economic hardship.

title: Pykka – Upgradation of Sports Facilities at Gram Panchayat Level
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Construction/upgradation of mini stadiums, multipurpose halls and sports grounds at village level. 2 lakh+ grounds to be developed nationwide.
eligibility_summary: Rural youth in Gram Panchayat areas benefiting from new/upgraded sports grounds.

title: National Young Leaders Programme (NYLP)
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Leadership training camps, exposure visits and award for young leaders aged 15–29 for community service and social impact work.
eligibility_summary: Young people aged 15–29 years engaged in community development and social change activities.

title: Rajiv Gandhi National Creche Scheme (RGNCS)
ministry: Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports
benefits: Subsidized crèche services (₹1/day for BPL families) for children aged 6 months to 6 years at 9,000+ crèche centres while mothers work.
eligibility_summary: Working and ailing mothers with children aged 6 months to 6 years.

title: PM Suryodaya Yojana – Rooftop Solar for 1 Crore Homes
ministry: Ministry of Power
benefits: Free rooftop solar for 1 crore homes. Up to 300 units free per month with net metering. Additional income for surplus power fed to grid.
eligibility_summary: BPL and lower-middle-income households in urban and rural areas with suitable rooftop.

title: Vahaan & Sarathi – Online Vehicle Registration & Driving Licence
ministry: Ministry of Road Transport & Highways
benefits: Online vehicle registration, RC, driving licence renewal without visiting RTO. Home delivery of DL and RC. Integration with DigiLocker for paperless transport.
eligibility_summary: All vehicle owners and applicants for driving licences across India.

title: Namami Gange Programme – Ganga Rejuvenation
ministry: Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
benefits: ₹20,000 crore programme for sewage treatment plants, ghats, crematoriums, afforestation and biodiversity conservation along River Ganga.
eligibility_summary: Residents of towns and villages along River Ganga in 5 states benefiting from clean Ganga.

title: Per Drop More Crop – Micro Irrigation Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of Water Resources, River Development & Ganga Rejuvenation
benefits: 55% subsidy (70% for small/marginal farmers) on drip and sprinkler systems. Online application through MIS portal. Technical support for installation.
eligibility_summary: All farmers seeking to adopt micro-irrigation for better water efficiency.

title: e-SHRAM Portal – Unorganised Worker Registration
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: Free registration for unorganised workers. ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability insurance, priority for government welfare schemes and social security.
eligibility_summary: All unorganised workers aged 16–59 years not covered by EPFO/ESIC.

title: Pradhan Mantri Laghu Vyapari Maan-dhan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: ₹3,000/month pension at age 60 for small traders and shopkeepers. Government matches monthly contribution of ₹55–₹200 for 18–40 year olds.
eligibility_summary: Small traders, shopkeepers and self-employed persons with turnover up to ₹1.5 crore.

title: Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare (BOCW)
ministry: Ministry of Labour and Employment
benefits: Scholarship for children, maternity benefit (₹20,000), death benefit (₹1 lakh), disability pension and accident insurance for registered construction workers.
eligibility_summary: Construction workers registered with state BOCW welfare boards.

title: Merit-cum-Means Scholarship for Minorities (Technical/Professional)
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Full course fee + ₹10,000 maintenance allowance per year for minority community students in technical and professional courses (engineering, medicine, MBA).
eligibility_summary: Minority students in technical/professional courses with 50%+ marks and family income below ₹2.5 lakh.

title: USTTAD – Upgrading Skills & Training in Traditional Arts
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Free training in traditional arts and crafts for minority community members. ₹3,000–₹4,500/month stipend during training, market linkage support.
eligibility_summary: Minority community artisans and youth seeking training in traditional/heritage crafts.

title: Nai Manzil – Integrated Education and Livelihood
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Bridge course for Class 8/10 equivalent certificate + vocational training for minority youth who dropped out of school. Stipend and placement support.
eligibility_summary: Minority youth aged 17–35 who could not complete formal schooling.

title: Seekho aur Kamao – Learn and Earn for Minority Youth
ministry: Ministry of Minority Affairs
benefits: Skill training in organised sector job roles with 75% placement guarantee. Stipend of ₹1,000–₹1,500/month. Priority to Class 8–12 pass minority youth.
eligibility_summary: Minority youth aged 14–45 years with education from Class 8 and above.

title: Pradhan Mantri Vanbandhu Kalyan Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Convergence of 47 central schemes for tribal welfare. Special focus on Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups (PVTGs) — housing, road, solar, health.
eligibility_summary: All tribal communities, with special focus on 75 Particularly Vulnerable Tribal Groups.

title: Tribal Research Institutes (TRI) – Study Grants
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Research grants and fellowships for scholars studying tribal culture, language, economy and governance. Documentation of tribal traditions and languages.
eligibility_summary: Researchers, academics and tribal scholars engaged in tribal studies.

title: Tribal Health Action Plan – Free Malaria and TB Treatment
ministry: Ministry of Tribal Affairs
benefits: Free diagnosis and treatment for malaria, sickle cell disease, TB and malnutrition in tribal areas. Mobile health units and telemedicine for remote tribes.
eligibility_summary: Tribal population in forested and remote tribal areas with limited healthcare access.

title: Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP)
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Awareness campaigns, incentives for girl child education and mandatory monitoring of sex ratio at birth in 405 districts. Conditional cash transfer in some states.
eligibility_summary: Families with girl children, especially in districts with low sex ratio at birth.

title: Integrated Child Development Services (ICDS) – Anganwadi
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
benefits: Free supplementary nutrition, pre-school education, health check-ups, immunization and nutrition counselling through 14 lakh+ Anganwadi centres.
eligibility_summary: Children aged 0–6 years, pregnant women and lactating mothers in all states.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Government shares 25% of prescribed stipend (max ₹1,500/month) with employers for hiring apprentices. 5.5 lakh+ apprenticeships per year.
eligibility_summary: Youth aged 14–21 years (up to 24 for reserved categories) seeking apprenticeship training in establishments.

title: Industrial Training Institutes (ITIs) – Vocational Training
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: Government ITIs provide subsidized or free 1–2 year vocational training in 130+ trades (Electrician, Fitter, Welder, Draughtsman etc.) with NCVT certificate.
eligibility_summary: Youth who have completed Class 8/10 seeking vocational/technical skill training.

title: Skill India Digital (SID) – Free Online Skilling
ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
benefits: 1 crore+ free online skill courses with government-backed certificates on the Skill India Digital portal. AI-driven learning paths and job matching.
eligibility_summary: Any Indian aged 15+ seeking free skill development and employment-linked learning.

title: Scheme for Cultural Heritage Youth Leadership
ministry: Ministry of Culture
benefits: Training 2,000 young leaders per year in cultural heritage conservation, museum management and performing arts. Certificate courses at ASI and cultural institutions.
eligibility_summary: Youth aged 18–30 years with interest in cultural heritage and performing arts.

title: Scheme for Protection & Preservation of Endangered Languages
ministry: Ministry of Culture
benefits: Documentation of endangered languages, publication of dictionaries, fellowships for linguists and digital archiving. ₹5 lakh per language documentation project.
eligibility_summary: Linguists, language scholars and communities working to preserve endangered languages.

title: Zonal Cultural Centres (ZCC) Grant for Folk Arts
ministry: Ministry of Culture
benefits: Financial support to folk artists, theatre groups and craftspersons from 7 Zonal Cultural Centres. Mini grants of ₹5,000–₹30,000 for performances and workshops.
eligibility_summary: Folk artists, musicians, craftspersons and traditional performing artists across regions.

title: Army Welfare Education Society (AWES) – Schools for Army Families
ministry: Ministry of Defence
benefits: Quality education at Army Public Schools with subsidized fees for children of defence personnel. CBSE affiliated schools at 134 stations.
eligibility_summary: Children of serving and retired Army personnel at APS schools.

title: Resettlement Training Programme for Ex-Servicemen
ministry: Ministry of Defence
benefits: Free skill training at 6 months to 1 year for ex-servicemen in computer, security management, hospitality and agriculture. Placement assistance at DGR.
eligibility_summary: Ex-servicemen within 5 years of retirement from Army, Navy or Air Force.

title: Blue Revolution – Neel Kranti Mission
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: Integrated development of marine and inland fisheries. Subsidized trawlers, ice plants, cold storage, harbours and deep-sea fishing boats.
eligibility_summary: Marine and inland fishermen, fish farmers and fishing cooperatives.

title: National Livestock Health and Disease Control Programme
ministry: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
benefits: Free vaccination against FMD, Brucellosis and other major animal diseases. Mobile veterinary units for doorstep treatment of livestock.
eligibility_summary: Farmers with cattle, buffaloes, pigs, small ruminants and other livestock.

title: Pension Adalat – Speedy Pension Grievance Redressal
ministry: Ministry of Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions
benefits: Quarterly Pension Adalats for speedy resolution of pensioners' grievances. Online CPENGRAMS portal for complaint tracking. Resolution within 60 days.
eligibility_summary: Central Government pensioners and family pensioners with pending pension grievances.

title: Harit Sagar – Green Port Guidelines
ministry: Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways
benefits: Financial support for shore power, electric vehicles, solar panels and waste management systems at major ports. 30% reduction in carbon emissions target by 2030.
eligibility_summary: Shipping companies, port workers and businesses at major ports adopting green practices.

title: Incredible India Bed and Breakfast Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Tourism

ministry: Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation

eligibility_summary: Graduates (any discipline) seeking government contractual positions as surveyors.

ministry: Ministry of Steel

eligibility_summary: Scrap processors, steel manufacturers and investors setting up recycling units.

title: PM eVIDYA – Multi-Modal Digital Learning Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Education

ministry: Ministry of Education

ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: Elementary and secondary school teachers and head teachers in government schools.

ministry: Ministry of Education

ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: All girl students and SC/ST/BPL boys enrolled in government schools from Class 1 to 8.

title: Samagra Shiksha – Free Textbooks and Learning Materials
ministry: Ministry of Education

ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: Students studying in government upper primary, secondary, and higher secondary schools.

ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: Citizens, professionals, organizations, and alumni willing to contribute services or assets to government schools.

ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: Students enrolled in designated PM SHRI schools across all states and union territories.

title: Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Lateral Entry Scheme (Class 9 & 11)

eligibility_summary: Girl students studying in Classes 9 to 12 in secondary schools in identified backward blocks.

ministry: Ministry of Education

title: Scheme for Infrastructure Development in Minority Institutions (IDMI)

ministry: Ministry of Education

title: Rashtriya Uchchatar Shiksha Abhiyan (RUSA) – Research & Innovation Grants
ministry: Ministry of Education

eligibility_summary: Faculty, researchers, and postgraduate students enrolled in state public universities.

benefits: Prototype grant up to ₹10 lakh per innovator and free access to state-of-the-art PRAYAS fabrication laboratories to convert scientific ideas into working hardware prototypes.
eligibility_summary: Individual innovators and early-stage startup founders with an innovative hardware or deep-tech concept.

title: DST NIDHI-EIR – Entrepreneurs-in-Residence Fellowship
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Living stipend of up to ₹30,000 per month for 12 to 18 months, accompanied by free co-working space, mentorship, and business development support at approved incubators.
eligibility_summary: Aspiring technology entrepreneurs with a graduated degree who are committed to commercializing an innovation.

title: DST NIDHI Seed Support System (SSS) for Early Startups
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Seed capital investment of ₹25 lakh to ₹1 crore as debt or soft equity to help incubated deep-tech startups scale manufacturing and customer validation.
eligibility_summary: Tech startups incubated in DST-supported Technology Business Incubators (TBIs) with registered IP.

title: DST Technology Business Incubators (TBI) Programme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grants up to ₹15 crore to academic institutions to set up full-fledged startup incubators providing wet labs, supercomputing, and legal advisory.
eligibility_summary: Academic and research institutions establishing technology business incubation facilities.

title: DST NIDHI Accelerator Programme for Fast Scaling Startups
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Structured 3-to-6 month fast-track acceleration with international investor demo days and pilot deployment funding for proven technological innovations.
eligibility_summary: High-potential startups with functional products seeking venture capital readiness.

title: BIRAC Biotechnology Ignition Grant (BIG) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grant-in-aid of up to ₹50 lakh for 18 months for commercialization-oriented proof-of-concept projects in healthcare, agriculture, and industrial biotech.
eligibility_summary: Individual biotech innovators, PhD scholars, doctors, and early startups under 5 years of incorporation.

title: BIRAC SPARSH – Social Innovation Programme for Products: Affordable & Relevant to Societal Health
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹50,000 plus mini kick-start grant of ₹5 lakh to develop affordable healthcare and diagnostic solutions for underserved communities.
eligibility_summary: Indian graduates, postgraduates in biomedical sciences, engineering, and medicine.

title: BIRAC BIPP – Biotechnology Industry Partnership Programme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Government cost-sharing grant of 30% to 50% for high-risk, game-changing biotechnology product discovery in vaccines, biopharmaceuticals, and genomics.
eligibility_summary: Registered Indian biotech companies with in-house DSIR-recognized R&D units.

title: BIRAC SBIRI – Small Business Innovation Research Initiative
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grants and soft loans at 2% simple interest for early-stage validation of innovative biotechnology concepts by small and medium biotech enterprises.
eligibility_summary: Small and medium Indian biotech enterprises with fewer than 500 employees.

title: BIRAC PACE – Promoting Academic Research Conversion to Enterprise
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grant support up to ₹50 lakh for academic researchers to validate laboratory discoveries and establish proof of principle for industrial licensing.
eligibility_summary: Faculty members, scientists, and researchers in public or private higher education institutions.

title: BIRAC BioNEST – Bio-Incubators Nurturing Entrepreneurship for Scaling Technologies
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Infrastructure funding to universities to operate certified bioincubators offering sterile tissue culture, fermentation suites, and cleanroom facilities.
eligibility_summary: Biotech startups and academic innovators needing access to certified wet laboratory infrastructure.

title: DBT Junior Research Fellowship (DBT-JRF) / BET Examination
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Fellowship of ₹37,000/month (JRF) scaling to ₹42,000/month (SRF) plus HRA and ₹30,000 annual research contingency grant for pursuing PhD in biotechnology.
eligibility_summary: Postgraduates in Biotechnology, Bioinformatics, and Life Sciences qualifying the Biotechnology Eligibility Test (BET).

title: DBT Postdoctoral Fellowship (DBT-PDF) in Life Sciences
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹54,000 plus HRA and research contingency grant of ₹50,000 per year for 2 years to pursue postdoctoral work in top institutes.
eligibility_summary: Candidates holding a PhD or MD/MS in biotechnology and life sciences, under 35 years of age.

title: DBT Ramalingaswami Re-entry Fellowship for Indian Scientists
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly consolidated fellowship of ₹1.25 lakh, HRA, and annual research grant of ₹10 lakh for 5 years to bring overseas Indian scientists back to national institutions.
eligibility_summary: Overseas Indian scientists with PhD and minimum 3 years of postdoctoral experience abroad wishing to return to India.

title: DBT Star College Scheme for Undergraduate Life Science Education
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grants up to ₹25 lakh per department to provide undergraduate science students hands-on experiments, minor research projects, and specialized faculty training.
eligibility_summary: Undergraduate colleges teaching botany, zoology, chemistry, physics, and biotechnology.

title: DBT Skill Vigyan Programme in Biotechnology
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Free 3-to-6 month hands-on vocational courses in molecular diagnostics, tissue culture, and bioprocess operations with monthly training stipend of ₹5,000.
eligibility_summary: 10+2 science pass-outs, polytechnic diploma holders, and fresh life science graduates.

title: DBT BUILDER – Boost to University Interdisciplinary Life Science Departments
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Institutional support up to ₹10 crore to modernize university life science curricula, install automated DNA sequencing facilities, and encourage inter-departmental research.
eligibility_summary: UGC-recognized universities with strong credentials in life science postgraduate teaching.

title: CSIR Junior Research Fellowship (CSIR-JRF) in Physical & Chemical Sciences
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹37,000 plus HRA and ₹20,000 annual contingency grant for first 2 years, upgradable to SRF at ₹42,000/month for 3 years.
eligibility_summary: M.Sc or equivalent degree holders qualifying Joint CSIR-UGC NET for JRF in chemical, earth, mathematical, and physical sciences.

title: CSIR Senior Research Fellowship (CSIR-SRF-Direct)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Direct SRF award of ₹42,000 per month plus HRA and contingency grant for scholars with at least two years of proven research experience and indexed publications.
eligibility_summary: Postgraduates in science or engineering with at least one published research paper in an SCI journal.

title: CSIR Research Associateship (CSIR-RA)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹58,000–₹67,000 plus HRA and annual research contingency grant of ₹20,000 to conduct independent post-PhD research in CSIR/academic labs.
eligibility_summary: Indian citizens with a PhD degree in science or M.Tech/MD with research publications.

title: CSIR-Nehru Science Postdoctoral Research Fellowship
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Prestigious fellowship of ₹65,000 per month plus HRA and annual contingency grant of ₹3 lakh for 2 years to work with senior scientists in CSIR national laboratories.
eligibility_summary: PhD holders in basic or applied sciences within 3 years of thesis defense with high academic standing.

title: SERB Ramanujan Fellowship for Outstanding Overseas Scientists
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Monthly fellowship of ₹1.35 lakh plus annual research grant of ₹7 lakh for 5 years to attract brilliant Indian researchers working abroad back to Indian institutions.
eligibility_summary: Brilliant Indian scientists and engineers working abroad with proven record of high scientific impact.

title: CSIR Shanti Swarup Bhatnagar (SSB) Prize for Science and Technology
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Cash award of ₹5 lakh, a plaque, citation, and monthly honorarium of ₹15,000 up to age 65, recognizing outstanding research contributions made primarily in India.
eligibility_summary: Indian scientists under 45 years of age engaged in notable research in biological, chemical, earth, engineering, or physical sciences.

title: CSIR Young Scientist Award & Research Grant
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Cash prize of ₹50,000, citation plaque, and a non-recurring research grant of ₹25 lakh spread over 5 years for independent scientific investigations.
eligibility_summary: Scientists working in CSIR laboratory networks under 35 years of age.

title: CSIR Innovation Award for School Children (CIASC)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: 15 annual cash prizes (First prize ₹1 lakh) and assistance in filing Indian patents for original novel technological and biological inventions designed by school kids.
eligibility_summary: School children below 18 years of age enrolled in any recognized Indian school.

title: CSIR-800 Societal Technologies Programme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Field deployment of low-cost water filters (Terafil), essential oil distillation units, bio-toilets, and post-harvest drying technologies to boost rural livelihoods.
eligibility_summary: Farmers, rural youth, SHGs, and local artisans in economically backward blocks.

title: DST Technology Development Programme (TDP)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1 crore for academic-industry partnerships to scale laboratory bench concepts to pre-commercial pilot plant trials.
eligibility_summary: Joint applications by academic faculty and industrial engineering partners.

title: DST Waste Management Technologies Programme
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: R&D grants up to ₹75 lakh for developing indigenously manufactured systems to recycle electronic waste, plastics, industrial effluent, and agricultural crop residue.
eligibility_summary: Scientists and environmental engineers in universities, national labs, and technology startups.

title: DST Clean Energy Research Initiative (CERI)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Project grants of ₹50 lakh to ₹3 crore to develop next-generation solar photovoltaics, green hydrogen electrolyzers, sodium-ion batteries, and supercapacitors.
eligibility_summary: Research faculty and scholars working in renewable and clean energy science disciplines.

title: DST Water Technology Initiative (WTI)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Grants for creating decentralized water purification systems, fluoride and arsenic removal filters, and membrane technologies for water-scarce villages.
eligibility_summary: Academic researchers, engineers, and social enterprises addressing clean water access.

title: DST National Climate Change Programme – Himalayan Ecosystem Research
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Field monitoring grants, high-altitude field stations, and doctoral fellowships studying glacier retreat, weather extremes, and ecological resilience.
eligibility_summary: Geoscientists, glaciologists, and environmental researchers in recognized institutes.

title: DST Cognitive Science Research Initiative (CSRI)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Research grants up to ₹40 lakh and Postdoctoral Fellowships (₹55,000/month) to study brain mapping, language cognition, and neuro-rehabilitation.
eligibility_summary: Researchers in psychology, neuroscience, linguistics, and computer science holding a PhD.

title: DST National Mission on Interdisciplinary Cyber-Physical Systems (NM-ICPS)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Technology Innovation Hub (TIH) fellowships (up to ₹50,000/month) and prototype grants for AI, quantum tech, autonomous robotics, and IoT research.
eligibility_summary: M.Tech and PhD scholars, postdocs, and young entrepreneurs working at 25 designated national TIH hubs.

title: DST Science for Equity, Empowerment and Development (SEED)
ministry: Ministry of Science and Technology
benefits: Field demonstration funding up to ₹50 lakh for voluntary organizations and scientists implementing tailored agricultural, energy, and artisanal tools for SC/ST groups.
