faqs.question: How much coverage is provided per family per year for hospitalization and surgical procedures?
faqs.answer: The scheme offers coverage up to [?]5 Lacs per family per year, with [?]1 Lac for secondary ailments and [?]4 Lacs for high-cost tertiary ailments.

faqs.question: Can pre-existing conditions be covered under the Risk Cover?
faqs.answer: Yes, pre-existing conditions/diseases are covered under the Risk Cover, including hospitalization and follow-up care benefits.

faqs.question: What expenses are included in the hospitalization expense benefits package?
faqs.answer: The package covers registration charges, bed charges (General Ward), nursing and boarding charges, surgeons' fees, and other associated costs.

faqs.question: Is there coverage for diagnostic tests like X-ray, MRI, and CT Scan?
faqs.answer: Yes, radiology tests, including X-ray, MRI, CT Scan, etc., are covered under the pathology and radiology tests package.

faqs.question: What is the duration of cashless services for the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: Cashless services are available to the beneficiary from reporting to up to 10 days after discharge from the hospital.

faqs.question: Can medical and surgical packages be taken together for the same patient in the same hospitalization episode?
faqs.answer: No, medical and surgical packages cannot be taken together for the same patient in the same episode of hospitalization.

faqs.question: What is the significance of complications in the context of the procedures?
faqs.answer: Complications are considered a part of the procedure, and they are covered under the policy.

faqs.question: What are the exclusions under the policy regarding hospitalization purposes?
faqs.answer: Conditions not requiring hospitalization, hospitalization primarily for evaluation/diagnostic purposes, and dental treatments for cosmetic or aesthetic procedures are excluded.

faqs.question: Is fertility-related procedures covered under the policy?
faqs.answer: No, fertility-related procedures are excluded from the policy coverage.

faqs.question: Are drugs and alcohol-induced illnesses covered?
faqs.answer: No, illnesses induced by drugs and alcohol are excluded from the policy coverage.

faqs.question: Is there coverage for mental disorders under the medical packages?
faqs.answer: Yes, mental disorders are covered under the Medical Packages, including Emergency Room Packages for care requiring less than 12 hrs stay.

faqs.question: How is the unit of enrollment determined?
faqs.answer: A family is the unit of enrollment, and the head of the family can be either the husband or wife, based on the defined SECC Database.

faqs.question: What is the specific coverage for high-cost tertiary ailments per family per year?
faqs.answer: The coverage for high-cost tertiary ailments is [?]4 Lacs per family per year under the Ayushman Bharat-National Health Protection Mission.

faqs.question: Can beneficiaries claim benefits for pre and post-hospitalization expenses?
faqs.answer: Yes, beneficiaries can claim benefits for pre and post-hospitalization expenses, including consultation, diagnostic tests, and medicines.

faqs.question: How are family units determined for enrollment?
faqs.answer: A family unit for enrollment is based on the SECC Database, and every family in the database is entitled to claim benefits under the mission.

faqs.question: What is the duration covered for pre-hospitalization and post-hospitalization expenses?
faqs.answer: Pre-hospitalization expenses up to 3 days and post-hospitalization expenses up to 10 days are covered for all medicines and diagnostic tests for the same ailment/surgery.

faqs.question: Are there specific specialties covered under the approved list of procedures?
faqs.answer: Yes, there is an approved list of procedures in 23 specialties, including Cardiology, Orthopedics, Urology, and Mental Disorders, among others.

title: Dulari Kanya Scheme
ministry: Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details: Announced on 15th August 2016 by the Hon’ble Chief Minister of Arunachal Pradesh, “Dulari Kanya” is a scheme for the girl child by the Directorate of Family Welfare, Department of Health & Family Welfare of the Govt. of Arunachal Pradesh. The objective of the scheme is to end the preference between male and female child, encouragement of institutional delivery, immunization of children, to end child marriage and overall empowerment of females in all spheres of their life. An amount of ₹ 20,000/- shall be deposited in the fixed deposit Bank Account (Minor Account) of the girl child born in any Government Hospital or Government recognised private hospital. Maturity amount can be withdrawn by the beneficiary on attaining the age of 18 years, which would be subject to verification by the concerned DMO of the respective districts.
benefits_detailed:
1. An amount of ₹ 20,000/- shall be deposited in the fixed deposit Bank Account (Minor Account) of the girl child born in any Government Hospital or Government recognised private hospital. 
1. Maturity amount can be withdrawn by the beneficiary on attaining the age of 18 years, which would be subject to verification by the concerned DMO of the respective districts.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The girl child should be born in a Government Hospital or Government recognized private hospital in the state of Arunachal Pradesh.
1. The father/guardian should belong to a schedule tribe Arunachal Pradesh or a domicile resident of Arunachal Pradesh or possess a household residential certificate.
1. The scope of the scheme is restricted to a maximum of first two live girl child.

title: CM Golden Jubilee Rural Housing

benefits: Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
eligibility_summary: Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.
details:
**CM Golden Jubilee Rural Housing** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Department of Housing & Urban Development** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Arunachal Pradesh.

The scheme was established under the **Housing & Shelter** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Arunachal Pradesh** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **80 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Unemployed, Self-employed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

ministry: Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Department of Skill Development & Employment
benefits: Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
eligibility_summary: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
details:
**Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Department of Skill Development & Employment** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Arunachal Pradesh.

The scheme was established under the **Skills & Employment** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Arunachal Pradesh** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **35 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Unemployed, Student.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://eservice.arunachal.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Swavalamban Yojana?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Arunachal Pradesh - Department of Skill Development & Employment.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required to apply?
faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.question: How are the benefits or funds disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://eservice.arunachal.gov.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

title: Orunodoi 3.0 Scheme
ministry: Government of Assam - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
benefits_detailed:
1) The Assam govt. runs this scheme for those women who belong to the low-income groups of society to support them financially.
2) Each beneficiary will get 1250 rupees per month on the very first date of every month. The Orunodoi 3.0 Scheme covers the expenses for medicines for taking care of health needs, which is 400 rupees per family; Rs. 200 per family is given to provide a 50% subsidy for the 4 kg of pulses of a family; 80 rupees are given as the 50% subsidy for 4 kg of sugar; 150 rupees are given for the fruits & vegetables; Rs. 150 are given for the essential needs; Rs. 170 for covid-19 expenses; and Rs. 250 for a subsidy for 50 units of electricity. And this amount is consolidated to Rs. 1250 per month for a family.
3) Orunodoi Scheme 3.0 will provide financial assistance of Rs. 1250 per month through Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility_detailed: If any of the following criteria is observed in case of an applicant, it will be sufficient for inclusion under the scheme. 1. Widow, unmarried (above the age of 45 yrs) 2. Transgender 3. Person with disability, as defined in the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, irrespective of gender 4. Old/Infirm woman including those residing in Government registered old age home 5. Women of the Household, where earning members are either disabled or aged (more than sixty years of age) 6. Woman in household, where any member is suffering from HIV/ Thalassemia/ Haemophilia/ Cerebral Palsy/ Leprosy/ Autism spectrum disorder 7. Woman in household without shelter 8. Destitute woman living on alms 9. Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) woman beneficiary 10. Women in the household, composite income of which is less than Rs.2 lacs per annum.

children.text: Step 01: The only way to apply for this scheme is through the application form.
Step 02: To take benefit from the scheme, the family has to nominate a woman from their home.
Step 03: Then all the information of the nominated beneficiary will have to be filled in the Application Form as follows:
•	Priority Status: D - Divorced, S - Separated, W - Widow, DY - Divyang.
•	Bank Passbook First Page. (Yes or No).
Step 04: The duly filled Application Form by the applicant shall be submitted to her PS committee or in a Gram Panchayat Office.
Step 05:  After submission of the Application Form, an acknowledgement slip will be given to the applicant by the PS committee or in a Gram Panchayat Office.
Step 06:  This acknowledgement slip will be the proof that the Applicant's Application Form has been submitted.
Step 07:  Then various level committees will scrutinize the applications received and verify them thoroughly.

Step 08:  After thorough verification, the list of selected and eligible beneficiaries will be uploaded on the DIDS portal and they will get the amount transferred to their bank accounts on the 10th day of every month.

Applicant Details: • Block/ULB Name. • Gram Panchayat/Town Name. • Village Name/Ward Number. • Locality in Town. • Applicant First Name. • Applicant Middle Name. • Applicant Last Name. • Gender. • Age as on 01.04.2020. • House Number. • Locality. • Police Station Name. • Pin Code. • Contact/Mobile Number. title: Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme
ministry: Government of Bihar - Department of Higher & School Education
benefits: Full tuition reimbursement, annual book grant of ₹15,000, and free competitive exam coaching for merit students.
eligibility_summary: Students belonging to economically weaker families pursuing secondary or higher education.
details: The Department of Education introduced a scheme named &quot;**Bihar Student Credit Card Scheme**&quot;. Its aim is to provide financial aid to students to complete their higher education. In this scheme, the students can avail loans of up to ₹4 lakhs at minimal interest rates. They can utilize these funds for financing courses like B.Sc, B.A, B.Tech, or MBBS. This scheme is specifically for all those students who are interested in pursuing higher education but due to lack of financial resources, they are not able to pursue the same.
benefits_detailed:
The eligible students will get the following benefits under this scheme:-

   1. A maximum loan amount of ₹4 lakh.
   1. Loan can be availed for polytechnic, technical and general courses.
   1. This assistance may be utilized for purchasing of books and laptops or pay any kind of fees.
   1. Repayment of the loan starts once the course has been completed and student have secured a job.
   1. The interest rate of the loan is 1% for Divyang, transgender, and girl students.
   1. The recovery procedures are flexible since the loan is government-owned.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Bihar state and should be at least 25 years.
   1. The applicant must have passed the class 12th.
   1. The applicant must get admission to a course in an authorized institute.
   1. The applicant must complete the entire course.

title: Mukhyamantri Vridhjan Pension Yojana
ministry: Government of Bihar - Department of Social Welfare
benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details: &quot;Pension Yojana (JBOCWWB)&quot; is a scheme by the Department of Labour, Employment, Training &amp; Skill Development Govt of Jharkhand. This is a 100% State Sponsored Scheme. Only the residents/domicile of the state of Jharkhand can apply to this scheme. Applications for this scheme are accepted online through the official website of the department. The scheme provides pension of ₹ 1,000/- per month to those who have contributed to the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board) for at least 30 years.
benefits_detailed: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be a domicile in the state of Jharkhand.
1. The applicant should have been a Worker registered with the Jharkhand Building and Other Construction Worker Welfare Board (JBOCWW Board).
1. The applicant should be between 18-60 years of age.
1. The applicant should be at least 60 years of age in order to receive the pension.
1. The applicant should have engaged in construction work such as masons, carpenters, electricians, porters, painters, etc.
1. The registered worker should have made continuous contributions for 30 years.

faqs.question: What is the “Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana”?
faqs.answer: The "Mukhyamantri Mahila Udyami Yojana" is a component of the "Mukhyamantri Udyami Yojana," aimed at promoting entrepreneurship and self-employment among women and transgender individuals in Bihar.

faqs.question: What is the main objective of this scheme?
faqs.answer: The main objective of the scheme is to empower women and transgender individuals by providing financial assistance to establish and operate business ventures, fostering economic growth and self-reliance.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant must be a permanent resident of Bihar, be a female or transgender, and be aged between 18 and 50 years.

faqs.question: What educational qualifications are required for the scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant should have passed at least 10+2, Intermediate, ITI, Polytechnic Diploma, or an equivalent qualification.

faqs.question: What type of businesses are eligible under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The business must be a proprietorship or partnership firm to qualify for assistance under this scheme.

faqs.question: What financial assistance is provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides up to [?]10,00,000/- in financial assistance, with 50% as a non-repayable grant and 50% as an interest-free loan.

faqs.question: Is there any interest charged on the loan component?
faqs.answer: The loan component is interest-free, with a nominal 1% interest charged under specific sub-schemes.

faqs.question: Does the scheme include training programs?
faqs.answer: Yes, mandatory training sessions are provided to enhance the entrepreneurial skills of applicants.

faqs.question: Can transgender individuals apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme is inclusive and provides benefits to transgender individuals along with women.

faqs.question: Is there any age limit for applicants?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants must be between 18 and 50 years of age to qualify for the scheme.

faqs.question: How is the financial assistance disbursed?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance is disbursed in installments, with the first installment released after the completion of mandatory training.

faqs.question: What documents are required to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Applicants need to provide proof of residence, educational certificates, identity proof, caste certificate (if applicable), and bank account details, among other required documents.

faqs.question: What happens after the application is approved?
faqs.answer: Once approved, applicants receive the sanctioned amount in their business account. They must utilize the funds as per the project guidelines provided by the department.

title: Saat Nischay - Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal
ministry: Government of Bihar - Department of Energy & Water Resources
benefits: Free 150-200 units domestic electricity or up to 50% state top-up subsidy on domestic solar rooftop plants.
eligibility_summary: Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.
details:
**Saat Nischay - Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Bihar - Department of Energy & Water Resources** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Bihar.

The scheme was established under the **Utility & Sanitation** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Free 150-200 units domestic electricity or up to 50% state top-up subsidy on domestic solar rooftop plants.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Bihar** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **90 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum, ₹5,00,000 to ₹8,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Self-employed, Unemployed, Homemaker, Retired.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Saat Nischay - Har Ghar Nal Ka Jal'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Bihar - Department of Energy & Water Resources.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.

faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://serviceonline.bihar.gov.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

ministry: Government of Chandigarh - Department of Social Welfare
benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details: The scheme “Widow Pension” was started by the Chandigarh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (CBOCWWB), Labour Department, Chandigarh. Under this scheme, financial assistance in the form of a monthly pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
benefits_detailed: Financial assistance of ₹1000/- per month in the form of pension shall be given to the widows of male registered construction workers of the Board.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The deceased worker should have been working at the establishment, registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965 and his contributions to the labour welfare fund should have been regularly received by the board.
   1. The financial assistance will be given on the production of the death certificate issued by the competent authority along with self-declaration for not withdrawing pension from any other sources/office/factory.
   1. The financial assistance will not be given to those beneficiaries who are covered under EPF.
   1. The widow of a male construction worker would be eligible to avail the benefit of this scheme only if the male construction worker was a member of the Board for at least the last six months.
   1. The widow should apply for the benefit of this scheme within one year.

faqs.question: What financial assistance is provided under the Widow Pension Scheme by the CBOCWWB?
faqs.answer: The Widow Pension Scheme offers financial assistance of [?]1000 per month in the form of a monthly pension to eligible widows of male registered construction workers affiliated with the Board.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for the Widow Pension Scheme by CBOCWWB?
faqs.answer: To be eligible for the Widow Pension Scheme, the deceased worker should have been employed at an establishment registered under the Punjab Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1965. Additionally, his contribution to the labour welfare fund should have been regularly received by the board.

faqs.answer: The "Skill Development" program is implemented by the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology (WIHG), under the Government of India.

faqs.question: Which students are eligible to apply for the "Skill Development" program?
faqs.answer: Students who are pursuing postgraduate degrees or are in the fourth or fifth year of integrated postgraduate programs in Earth sciences or related disciplines are eligible to apply for the program.

faqs.answer: The program covers a wide range of Earth science disciplines including structural geology, geochemistry, sedimentology, geomorphology, tectonics, environmental geology, economic geology, paleontology, and related fields.

faqs.answer: The program provides hands-on, field-based and laboratory-based training along with participation in institution-led research activities during the training period.

faqs.question: Does the "Skill Development" program include seasonal training opportunities?
faqs.answer: Yes, the program offers both summer and winter training sessions to accommodate the academic calendars of different institutions.

faqs.answer: Students can apply through the official [website ](https://www.wihg.res.in/)of the Wadia Institute of Himalayan Geology where information regarding the program and application instructions are regularly updated.

faqs.question: Is there a selection process for the "Skill Development" program?
faqs.answer: Yes, the selection process typically involves screening of applications based on academic background, relevance of the research interest, and available seats for the training period.

faqs.question: What are the long-term benefits of attending the "Skill Development" program?
faqs.answer: Participants benefit by acquiring advanced field and laboratory skills, networking with Earth science professionals, and enhancing their academic and research profiles, which helps in future higher education or employment opportunities.

title: Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana
ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct financial support of ₹10,000 per year for procurement of quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment inputs.
eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers holding verified land records in the state.
details:
Rajiv Gandhi Kisan Nyay Yojana is a scheme of the Government of Chhattisgarh for the farmers and launched on May 21, 2020, on the death anniversary of Rajiv Gandhi.
The main objective of this scheme is to increase the agricultural area by encouraging the farmers for crop production.
Under this scheme, financial benefits will be transferred to the farmers. This amount will be transferred to the accounts of the farmers in 4 instalments. This scheme started during the Corona period has provided great relief to the farmers. In the initial year of the scheme, only paddy, maize and sugarcane crops were included but after that, few more types of following crops have been included in it.

1. Kodo Kutki.
1. Sugarcane.
1. Arhar.
1. Maize.
1. Soybean.
1. Pulses.
1. Oilseeds.
1. Fragrant paddy.
1. Other fortified rice.
1. Banana.
1. Papaya.
benefits_detailed:
- Maximum amount of 10000/- per acre will be paid to the farmers planting paddy and maize through debit in installments.
- The fixed FRP amount for sugarcane crop will be paid through DBT to farmers at the rate of Rs. 93.75 /- quintal i.e. maximum amount of 355 /- per quintal.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Chhattisgarh state.
1. The applicant should be a marginal farmer, small farmer or large farmer.
1. The age of the applicant should be above 18 years.
1. Farmers of all categories of landowners and forest lease holders are eligible to get the benefits of the scheme.

benefits_detailed:

- Women receiving less than ₹1000/- per month under social assistance programs and various pension schemes through the Samaj Kalyan Vibhag will receive additional assistance to a total ₹1,000/- per month.

- The applicant must be a married woman.

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria regarding marital status for applying to this financial assistance scheme?
faqs.answer: The applicant must be a married woman, widow, divorcee, or abandoned woman who is a local resident of Chhattisgarh.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum age requirement to qualify for the monthly financial assistance?
faqs.answer: Yes, the applicant must be 21 years or older as of 1st January of the year of application.

faqs.question: How much financial assistance will an eligible woman receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Each eligible beneficiary will receive ₹1,000 per month directly deposited into her Aadhaar-linked bank account.

faqs.question: What happens if a woman already receives some amount under other social assistance programs?
faqs.answer: If she receives less than ₹1,000, she will get additional assistance to make the total ₹1,000 per month.

faqs.question: How will the financial assistance amount be disbursed to the beneficiaries?
faqs.answer: The amount will be transferred directly into the applicant’s Aadhaar-linked DBT-enabled bank account.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory to have an Aadhaar-linked bank account to receive the benefits?
faqs.answer: Yes, the applicant must have her own Aadhaar-linked DBT-based bank account to receive the assistance.

faqs.question: Are there any tax-related exclusions for the applicant’s family under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, no member of the applicant’s family should be an income taxpayer.

faqs.question: Can a woman apply if any family member is employed by the government?
faqs.answer: No, if any family member is a government employee (permanent, temporary, or contractual), she is ineligible.

faqs.question: Are former or current MPs or MLAs or their family members eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, if any family member is or was an MP, MLA, or held certain government positions, the applicant is excluded.

faqs.question: What documents are required to prove local residency in Chhattisgarh?
faqs.answer: Acceptable documents include a residence certificate, ration card, or voter ID card.

faqs.question: Is a marriage certificate mandatory for married women applying to the scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, a marriage certificate or a certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat/local bodies is required.

faqs.question: What proof is needed if a woman is abandoned by her husband?
faqs.answer: An abandoned woman must submit a certificate issued by the society/ward/Gram Panchayat as proof.

faqs.question: Which documents can be submitted as proof of age for the applicant?
faqs.answer: Acceptable documents include a birth certificate, 10th/12th marksheet, PAN card, voter ID, or driving license.

faqs.question: Do applicants need to submit a self-declaration or affidavit?
faqs.answer: Yes, a self-declaration form or affidavit must be attached with the application.

ministry: Government of Chhattisgarh - Department of Commerce & MSME
benefits: Up to 35% margin money subsidy on bank loans up to ₹25 lakh for establishing micro-enterprises and service units.
eligibility_summary: Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.
details: In 2022, Chhattisgarh State Government started the "Mukhyamantri Noni Sashaktikaran Sahayata Yojana" for the girl child of the family. With this scheme, daughters of workers will be able to get education, employment and self-employment.
benefits_detailed: Financial Benefits: ₹ 20,000/- only first two girl child.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The girl's father or mother or both should be registered as a construction worker in the Board for a period of at least one year.
1. The daughter for whom application has been made should not be registered in any division under the Labor Department.
1. Only two daughters of registered construction workers will be eligible for incentive amount.
1. The age of the daughter should be at least 18 years and should not be more than 21 years. 
1. Daughter should be unmarried.
1. The daughter must have passed at least 10th class. 
1. There should be a running bank account in the name of the daughter
1. The Parents of the daughter must have been working as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the period of one year preceding the date of application.
1. For payment of incentive amount, self-declaration form will be mandatory regarding verification of the beneficiary being a construction worker and the information given by the applicant in the application.
1. Those girls beneficiaries who have already received assistance under Minimata Kanya Vivah Yojana/Rajmata Vijayaraje Kanya Vivah Assistance Yojana operated under the Board, will be not eligible for this scheme.

eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
1. The applicant should have passed class 12th from a government or non-government college.

details:

The scheme was established under the **Social Welfare & Empowerment** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. ### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:

3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Female** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Retired, Unemployed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

title: Mukhyamantri Vidyarthi Pratibha Yojana
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Higher & School Education
benefits: Full tuition reimbursement, annual book grant of ₹15,000, and free competitive exam coaching for merit students.
eligibility_summary: Students belonging to economically weaker families pursuing secondary or higher education.
details: The &quot;Pratibha Yojana&quot; was launched by the Tribal Affairs Department, Government of Madhya Pradesh on 01.09.2016 to encourage talented students of the Scheduled Tribe Category for higher education. This scheme provides financial assistance to Scheduled Tribe students who have passed national competitive examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, &amp; NDA and have taken admission in IIT, NIT, NLU, MBBS (government colleges located in Madhya Pradesh), AIIMS or NDA.
benefits_detailed:
Under this scheme, eligible students are provided with the following incentives:

  - A financial assistance of ₹50,000/- is provided to students whose annual parental income is up to ₹3,00,000/-.
  - A financial assistance of ₹25,000/- is provided to students whose annual parental income exceeds ₹3,00,000/-.

**Note:** The incentive amount is paid into the applicant’s bank account linked to Aadhaar.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be a student.
   1. The student should be a native of Madhya Pradesh.
   1. The student should belong to the Scheduled Tribe category.
   1. The applicant&#39;s annual family income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/-.
   1. The student should have qualified in any of the National Competitive Examinations such as JEE, NEET, CLAT, AIIMS, or NDA.
   1. The applicant should have been admitted to one of the following institutions:


  - IIT/NIT through JEE
  - Government colleges in Madhya Pradesh for NEET (MBBS only)
  - AIIMS
  - NLU through CLAT
  - NDA through UPSC

**Note 1:** The applicant&#39;s Aadhaar must be linked to the bank account.
**Note 2:** The applicant must have the receipt of admission to the institute.

title: Delhi Ladli Scheme
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details:
**Delhi Ladli Scheme** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Delhi - Department of Women & Child Development** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Delhi.

The scheme was established under the **Women & Child** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Delhi** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **60 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Female** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Homemaker, Unemployed, Farmer.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Delhi Ladli Scheme'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Delhi Ladli Scheme?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Delhi - Department of Women & Child Development.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required to apply?
faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.question: How are the benefits or funds disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

faqs.question: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
faqs.answer: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

faqs.question: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
faqs.answer: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

faqs.question: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
faqs.answer: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
faqs.answer: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
faqs.answer: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
faqs.answer: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

title: Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Skill Development & Employment
benefits: Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
eligibility_summary: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
details:
The scheme “Jai Bhim Mukhyamantri Pratibha Vikas Yojana” was launched by the Department for the Welfare of SC/ST/OBC/Minorities, Government of NCT of Delhi vide Cabinet Decision No.2526 Dated 12-12-2017.
**Objective:**
The objective of the scheme is to provide quality coaching for economically disadvantaged Scheduled Castes (SCs) candidates to enable them to compete in Competitive examinations and succeed in obtaining an appropriate job in the Public/Private sector.
**The courses for which the Coaching will be imparted shall be as follows:**

- Group A and B examinations are conducted by the Union Public Service Commission (UPSC), the Staff Selection Commission (SSC), various Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs), and Judicial Services Examination.
- Group A and B examinations conducted by the State Public Service Commission;
- Officers’ Grade examinations conducted by Banks, Insurance Companies, and Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
- Premier Entrance Examinations for admission in (a) engineering (e.g. IIT-JEE &amp; AIEEE), (b) Medical (e.g. AIPMT), (c) professional courses like Management (e.g. CAT) and Law (e.g. CLAT) and (d) such other disciplines, Government may decide from time to time.

**Quantum of Fee:** The admissible coaching fee in respect of various courses would be as under:- 
S**l. No.****Name of course for which coaching to be provided****Duration of Coaching****Maximum ceiling of Coaching fee paid to institution (inclusive of both govt. as well as student share) per candidate (in ₹)**1Civil Service (Preliminary)/State Civil Services (Preliminary)Minimum 5 Months40,0002Civil Service (Mains)/State Civil Services (Mains)Minimum 4 Months40,0003Entrance examinations for Engineering, Medical, MBA, and other professional coursesMinimum 4 Months40,0004Other Group A&amp;amp;amp;B examinations conducted by UPSC, State Public Service Commissioners (SPSCs), Group B Examinations conducted by SSC and (SPSCs)Minimum 4 Months30,0005Officers Grade examinations for recruitment in the Banks, LIC, GICs, PSUsMinimum 4 Months30,000**The ratio of the Candidates:**
The ratio of students who have completed their studies from Govt. and Private Schools to be coached under the Scheme will be 75:25.
benefits_detailed:
1. A monthly stipend of ₹2500/- per student will be paid for local students for attending the coaching classes. 
   1. Under the scheme, 75% of the admissible coaching fee amount is to be provided by the Government and the remaining 25% is to be borne by the students. 
   1. In case of students having a total family income of up to ₹2.00 lacs, a full admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt.

**Note 01:** The institute would have to pay a stipend to each student on a monthly basis through PFMS/ ECS or cheque. Cash payment would not be allowed.
**Note 02:** Benefits under the scheme can be availed by a particular student not more than twice, irrespective of the number of chances; he/she may be entitled to in a particular competitive examination. However, only 50 % of the admissible coaching fee is to be provided by the Govt. for students who avail of 2nd time coaching facility under the scheme. The coaching institution will also be required to take an undertaking from the students that they have not taken benefit more than twice under the scheme.
eligibility_detailed:
**Eligibility criteria for students:**

   1. Only students belonging to the Scheduled Caste category residing in Delhi &amp; who have passed 10th and 12th class (or studying in class XII) from the schools in Delhi, having a total family income of not more than ₹6.00 lakh per annum will be eligible under the scheme.
   1. The students must have secured a prescribed percentage of marks in the qualifying examinations for which free coaching is proposed to be imparted under the scheme.

**Note 01:** Sponsoring Department may also nominate some needy students for coaching under the selected institutions.
**Note 02:** Income and Caste Certificates issued by the office of the concerned District Magistrate should be obtained from the Students by the selected institutes.
**Note 03:** Where examination is conducted in two stages viz. Preliminary and Main, the candidates will be entitled to free coaching for both examinations. They will be entitled to free coaching for both Preliminary and Main examinations at their convenience. However, there will be no restriction on the number of chances for coaching for interview, if the candidate is selected for interview.
**Note 04:** The selected students shall have to attend all classes. In the event of any student remaining absent for more than 15 days, without any valid reason, the benefits of free coaching to him/her shall be discontinued and another student shall be taken in his/her place.
**Eligibility criteria for applying for Empanelment of Coaching Institutions:**

   1. The institute should be a registered body or run by any organization registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860/ Companies Act, 2013, or any other relevant Act of the State/Union Territory.
   1. The institute should have experience of at least 3 years as of the date of notification inviting applications from institutions for empanelment by the Department.
   1. The institute should have been fully functional for a minimum period of 3 years at the time of applying under this scheme and having a minimum enrolment of 100 students in the courses each year for at least two years, immediately prior to the year in which selected for empanelment.
   1. The institute must have the proper infrastructure to meet the entire requirement for providing quality coaching in the courses applied.

title: Delhi Mukhyamantri Start-up Policy
ministry: Government of Delhi - Department of Commerce & MSME
benefits: Up to 35% margin money subsidy on bank loans up to ₹25 lakh for establishing micro-enterprises and service units.
eligibility_summary: Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.
details:
**Delhi Mukhyamantri Start-up Policy** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Delhi - Department of Commerce & MSME** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Delhi.

The scheme was established under the **Business & Entrepreneurship** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Up to 35% margin money subsidy on bank loans up to ₹25 lakh for establishing micro-enterprises and service units.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Delhi** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **55 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Self-employed, Unemployed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Delhi Mukhyamantri Start-up Policy'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Delhi - Department of Commerce & MSME.

faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.

faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

title: Deen Dayal Swasthya Seva Yojana (DDSSY)
ministry: Government of Goa - Department of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
eligibility_summary: All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
details: To facilitate and take medical services to the next level, the State of Goa envisaged the present scheme to provide its people with quality medical care and treatment of diseases, hospitalization, and surgery through government and private hospitals.
benefits_detailed: **The benefit under this scheme shall be provided on a cashless basis to the beneficiaries, up to the limit of their annual coverage, and shall be as under:** 1. The insurance cover shall be up to ₹2,50,000/- per annum for a family of three or fewer members and up to ₹4,00,000/- for a family of four or more members. Under no case, the claim would exceed ₹4,00,000/- annually. 1. The insurance benefit can be availed of individually or collectively by members of the family. 1. An individual is free to take higher coverage from the insurance company by paying higher premiums, without having any impact on Government policy and facilities. 1. The facilities for 447 procedures shall be covered under the scheme.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant must be a resident of the state of Goa.
1. The applicant must have resided in Goa continuously for a minimum of five years or more.

faqs.question: What is the objective of the DDSSY scheme?
faqs.answer: The objective of the DDSSY scheme is to provide quality medical care and treatment, including hospitalization and surgeries, to the residents of Goa through government and private hospitals on a cashless basis.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for the DDSSY scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme covers all residents of Goa who have lived in the state for five years or more.

faqs.question: What is the insurance coverage provided under DDSSY?
faqs.answer: The insurance cover is up to [?]2,50,000/- per annum for a family of three or fewer members and up to [?]4,00,000/- for a family of four or more members. The maximum claim cannot exceed [?]4,00,000/- annually.

faqs.question: What documents are required to avail of the DDSSY scheme?
faqs.answer: Required documents include an Aadhar Card or enrolment slip, proof of residence in Goa for five years, a ration card to define the family, and additional documents for specific categories like caste certificates or disability certificates.

faqs.question: How can a beneficiary avail of the benefits under the DDSSY scheme?
faqs.answer: Beneficiaries can approach an Empanelled Health Care Provider (EHCP) listed on the DDSSY website. After consulting with a doctor, the hospital's DDSSY Sahayak will raise a pre-authorization request for the required procedure.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary opt for higher insurance coverage?

faqs.question: How many medical procedures are covered under the DDSSY scheme?

faqs.question: What should a beneficiary do if they are aware of the required procedure?
faqs.answer: If aware of the required procedure, beneficiaries can check the DDSSY website for a list of EHCPs performing that procedure and visit the hospital of their choice from the empanelled list.

title: Griha Aadhar Scheme
ministry: Government of Goa - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details: The "Griha Aadhar Scheme" is one of the flagship programmes of the Department of Women & Child Development, Government of Goa. The objective of the scheme is to address the problem of spiralling prices and to provide support to the housewives/homemakers from the middle, lower middle and poor sections of society, to maintain a reasonable standard of living for their families. Under this scheme, a monthly disbursement of an amount as prescribed under the scheme will be provided every month directly to the hands of the housewives/homemakers to achieve the objective.
benefits_detailed: Financial Assistance of ₹ 1,500/- per month.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be a married woman.
1. The applicant should be above the age of 18 years.
1. The applicant should be a resident of Goa for the last fifteen years.
1. The gross income of the husband and wife, taken together should not exceed ₹ 3,00,000/- per annum.
1. A widow with a minor child who is in receipt of benefits under the Dayanand Social Security Scheme (DSSS) rolled out by the Directorate of Social Welfare, Government of Goa shall be eligible for benefits under this scheme.

faqs.question: Who Is Considered A _Married Woman_ Under The Scheme's Eligibility Criteria
faqs.answer: The term "married woman" includes not only a woman who is currently married but also widows and divorcees. All these categories of women are eligible for the scheme, provided their gross income does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000 per annum.

faqs.question: How Is The "Gross Income" Of The Beneficiary Defined For The Purpose Of Eligibility Assessment?
faqs.answer: The term "gross income" refers to all income received by the beneficiary, such as salary, remuneration, earnings from profession, agriculture, business, or any other source of income. It includes all income before considering any statutory, essential, or other deductions that are required to be made from the gross income.

faqs.question: Are Widows And Divorcees Subject To The Same Income Limit As Married Women For Eligibility?
faqs.answer: Yes, widows and divorcees are subject to the same income limit of Rs. 3,00,000 per annum for eligibility under the scheme. As long as their gross income does not exceed this limit, they are eligible to avail the benefits.

faqs.question: Can You Provide Examples Of Income Sources Considered Under The Term "Gross Income"?
faqs.answer: "Gross income" includes various sources of earnings such as salary from employment, remuneration from work, income generated from professions, earnings from agriculture or business activities, and any other income received from various sources.

faqs.question: How Are Deductions Accounted For While Calculating The Gross Income For Eligibility?
faqs.answer: While calculating the gross income, no deductions for statutory, essential, or any other purposes are taken into account. The income considered is the total income before any deductions are made.

faqs.question: What Happens If The Beneficiary Fails To Submit The Life Certificate And Income Certificate As Required By The Scheme?
faqs.answer: If the beneficiary fails to submit the required Life Certificate and Income Certificate, the monthly financial assistance will be stopped immediately. However, upon receipt of the necessary certificates and meeting other conditions, the assistance will be resumed from the next month.

faqs.question: What Happens If The Beneficiary Does Not Withdraw The Financial Assistance For 6 Months Or More?
faqs.answer: If the beneficiary does not withdraw the financial assistance for a continuous period of 6 months or more, the accumulated amount will be reversed and issued in the form of a Demand Draft in favor of the Director, Directorate of Women & Child Development by the concerned bank.

faqs.question: What Are The Consequences Of Availing Benefits Under The Scheme Based On Incorrect Information Or False Declaration?
faqs.answer: If any beneficiary avails benefits under the scheme by providing wrong or false information, legal action will be initiated against them, and they will be disqualified from receiving benefits under any other government schemes.

faqs.question: How Is The Scheme's Implementation Facilitated To Address Any Difficulties That May Arise?
faqs.answer: A4: To handle any difficulties in implementing the scheme, a four-member committee has been constituted. The committee includes the Secretary (Women and Child Development) as Chairperson, a Social Worker appointed by the Government as Member, an Additional/Joint Secretary (Finance) as Member, and the Director of Women and Child Development as Member Secretary. The committee's decisions are final and binding on all concerned.

faqs.question: How Is The Financial Assistance Disbursed To The Beneficiaries?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance of Rs. 1500/- is directly paid into the savings bank account of the eligible beneficiary through ABPS/ACH/NEFT every month.

faqs.question: Can Widows And Divorcees Avail Of The Benefits Of This Scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the term 'married woman' in the scheme includes widows and divorcees as well. As long as their gross income does not exceed Rs. 3,00,000/- per annum, they are eligible for the financial assistance.

faqs.question: How Is The Financial Assistance Paid To The Beneficiaries?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance is paid every month directly into the savings bank account of the eligible beneficiary through ABPS (Aadhar Bridge Payment System)/ACH (Automated Credit House)/NEFT (National Electronic Fund Transfer) subject to other conditions.

faqs.question: How Much Financial Assistance Is Provided Under The Scheme?
faqs.answer: Under the scheme, eligible beneficiaries receive a monthly disbursement of Rs. 1500/- (Rupees one thousand five hundred only).

details:
The “Housing Subsidy Scheme” is implemented by the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board (GBOCWWB), Labour, Skill Development &amp; Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. The main objective of this scheme is to provide financial assistance to construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board to build their own houses.
            In order to provide financial relief to the construction workers by giving subsidies for the houses purchased by them and to provide social stability to the construction workers, the  &quot;Housing Subsidy&quot; schemewasn started in the year 2021-22. It is planned to provide financial relief and social stability to construction workers through providing subsidies.
benefits_detailed:
1. Under the scheme, the assistance of ₹1,50,000/- will be provided to registered construction workers for a duration of 5 years, with ₹30,000/- disbursed annually subject to the terms of assistance.
   1. The construction workers who have taken a loan up to a maximum of ₹15 lakhs to buy their house will be provided ₹30,000/- per year for the five years as per plan.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The construction workers registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board will be eligible to get the benefit of this scheme.
   1. At the time of applying for the benefits of this scheme, it will be mandatory to have at least the last 2 years of registration with the construction worker&#39;s board.
   1. To avail the benefit of this scheme the construction worker should have documented the building after the date of resolution of the scheme (29/06/2020). The application has to be made within one year from the date of the document mentioned in the house purchase document.
   1. The loan taken for a house purchased by a registered construction worker should not exceed ₹15 lakhs and the loan tenure should be 10 years or more.
   1. The registered construction worker benefiting from this scheme should not own any house or property in the joint name of the worker or his wife or joint, which guarantee has to be given by the worker in an affidavit as per the prescribed format herein.
   1. The registered construction worker has to submit the bank loan interest certificate/bank loan statement after the completion of the financial year to avail the assistance under the Housing Subsidy Scheme.
   1. The registered construction worker receiving benefits under this scheme has to submit a written proposal every year at the district office of the concerned board to get the remaining four years of assistance after receiving the assistance for the first time along with a copy of the in-principle approval letter and the annual statement of interest.
