title: Dayanand Social Security Scheme
ministry: Government of Goa - Department of Social Welfare
benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details:
**Dayanand Social Security Scheme** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Goa - Department of Social Welfare** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Goa.

The scheme was established under the **Social Welfare & Empowerment** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Goa** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **60** and **100 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Female** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Retired, Unemployed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://goaonline.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Dayanand Social Security Scheme'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Dayanand Social Security Scheme?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Goa - Department of Social Welfare.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required to apply?
faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.question: How are the benefits or funds disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://goaonline.gov.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

title: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct financial support of ₹10,000 per year for procurement of quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment inputs.
eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers holding verified land records in the state.
details:
**Details**
Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana is implemented by the Revenue Department of the Government of Gujarat in collaboration with the Agriculture and Co-operation Department. The Revenue Department is responsible for the implementation of the scheme, including the verification of crop damage and the disbursal of compensation to eligible farmers. The Agriculture and Co-operation Department provides technical assistance and support for the implementation of the scheme to ensure that farmers receive timely and adequate relief in case of crop damage due to natural calamities.
<br>

**Key Points**

   1. The main objective behind launching this scheme is to provide financial assistance to farmers of Gujarat in case of crop loss.
   1. Financial Assistance will only be provided to farmers if Crop Loss is due to natural calamities.
   1. No premium will have to pay by the farmers to get themselves registered under Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana.
   1. Financial Assistance will only be paid up to a maximum of 4 Hectares of Agricultural Land.
   1. Eligible Farmers can apply by visiting their nearest E Gram Centre to avail the benefit of financial assistance in case of crop loss.

<br>
benefits_detailed: Direct financial support of ₹10,000 per year for procurement of quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment inputs.
eligibility_detailed:
**Eligibility** 

1. The applicant must be a farmer residing in Gujarat state.
1. The applicant must have availed of a loan for agricultural purposes from a cooperative institution or a bank.
1. The applicant must have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake.
1. The applicant must possess the land for agricultural purposes in his/her name or have the right to cultivate such land.
1. The land should be surveyed by the Revenue Department of Gujarat and should have a record of rights.
1. The crop loss should be certified by the Revenue Department of Gujarat.
1. The applicant should have insured the crop under the Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana or any other crop insurance scheme recognized by the Government of Gujarat.

Farmers need to visit their nearest E Gram Centre to apply for financial assistance under Mukhyamantri Kisan Sahay Yojana in case of crop loss due to natural calamity.
The assistant present at the centre will fill out the application form for farmers free of cost.

After final approval from the department, the amount of financial assistance will be transferred to the given bank account of the farmer.

faqs.question: What is the maximum amount of financial assistance that a farmer can receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The maximum amount of financial assistance that a farmer can receive under the scheme is Rs. 20,000 per hectare, subject to a maximum of four hectares per farmer.

faqs.question: How is the financial assistance calculated under this scheme?
faqs.answer: The financial assistance is calculated based on the extent of crop damage suffered by the farmer. The extent of crop damage is assessed by a team of officials appointed by the government, who take into account various factors such as the type of crop, the stage of crop growth, and the severity of the natural calamity.

faqs.question: What types of crops are covered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: All crops, including horticultural crops, are covered under this scheme.

faqs.question: Is there any income criterion for availing of the financial assistance under this scheme?

faqs.question: Can a farmer apply for financial assistance under this scheme for crop loss suffered in the previous year?
faqs.answer: No, financial assistance can only be availed for crop loss suffered in the current year. However, in exceptional cases, the government may consider applications for the previous year's crop loss, subject to the availability of funds.

faqs.question: What is the age limit for availing of the benefits of this scheme?
faqs.answer: There is no age limit for availing of the benefits of this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

faqs.question: Can a farmer who has already received compensation from another government scheme for crop loss apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, a farmer who has already received compensation or financial assistance from any other government scheme or insurance policy for the same crop loss is not eligible to apply for this scheme.

faqs.question: Is it mandatory for the farmer to have taken a loan for agricultural purposes to be eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: No, it is not mandatory for the farmer to have taken a loan for agricultural purposes to be eligible for this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

faqs.question: What is the minimum landholding size required for a farmer to be eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: There is no minimum landholding size required for a farmer to be eligible for this scheme. However, the farmer must have legal ownership or a record of rights for the land used for agricultural purposes.

faqs.question: Can a farmer who has not insured their crops under any crop insurance scheme still apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, a farmer who has not insured their crops under any crop insurance scheme can still apply for this scheme. However, the farmer must fulfil the other eligibility criteria specified by the government.

faqs.question: Is it necessary for the farmer to have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake to be eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, it is necessary for the farmer to have suffered crop loss due to natural calamities such as drought, flood, or earthquake to be eligible for this scheme.

faqs.answer: Farmers can apply for this scheme by visiting the official website of the Revenue Department of Gujarat, downloading the application form, and submitting it along with the required documents to the nearest agricultural office or bank branch.

faqs.question: What are the required documents for applying to this scheme?
faqs.answer: The required documents for applying to this scheme include proof of land ownership, crop loss certificate, bank loan documents, and other relevant documents as specified in the application form.

faqs.answer: Yes, Farmers can also apply for this scheme by visiting the Taluka Mamlatdar's office or the District Collector's office to obtain the application form.

faqs.answer: No, there is no application fee for this scheme.

faqs.answer: The timeline for processing the application varies, but it generally takes a few weeks to process the application and disburse the financial assistance to eligible farmers

title: Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY)
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Higher & School Education
benefits: Full tuition reimbursement, annual book grant of ₹15,000, and free competitive exam coaching for merit students.
eligibility_summary: Students belonging to economically weaker families pursuing secondary or higher education.
details:
**Detailed** 
Mukhymantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana or MYSY Scholarship is a scholarship scheme that is offered to the economically weaker section students of Gujarat. All those students who wish to pursue higher education like diploma courses, engineering, pharmacy course, medical course, etc apply for MYSY scholarship every year.
<br>

**Objective**
The main objective of the MYSY Scholarship Scheme is to help those students financially who are not being able to finance their education due to low family income. Through this scholarship scheme, financial assistance will be provided to those students so that they can continue their education without any problem.
<br>

**Types of Scholarship Under MYSY Scholarship**
There are three types of scholarships that are offered under the MYSY Scholarship which are as follows:-

   1. Tuition fee grant
   1. Hostel grant
   1. Book/instruments grant

<br>

**Features and Benefits of the MYSY Scholarship**

   1. Under the MYSY scholarship scheme, non-reserve students will also get financial help for buying books and equipment.
   1. Those students who are in Gujarat medical education research society and dental courses will get financial assistance of Rs 10 lakh over 5 years
   1. For government jobs, there is an age relaxation given to all category students. This age relaxation is of 5 years
   1. All those students who wish to appear in the competitive exam will be provided training under training centers.
   1. The government will also provide assistance of Rs 1200 per month for 10 months if in that region there is no higher education facility or government hostel.
   1. All the students who have passed class 10th and 12th with 80% and have opted for diploma courses will get Rs 25000 per year or 50% fees whichever is less.
   1. Under the MYSY scholarship scheme free of cost outfits, reading material etc will be provided by the government

<br>
benefits_detailed: Full tuition reimbursement, annual book grant of ₹15,000, and free competitive exam coaching for merit students.
eligibility_detailed:
**Eligibility** 

   1. For scholarship in Diploma admissions, the candidate should have passed the Std X from a recognized board from the state of Gujarat with a minimum 80 percentile in the board examination
   1. For scholarship in Bachelor&#39;s degree programs, the candidates should have passed Std XII Science/ General stream from a recognized board from the state of Gujarat with a minimum 80 percentile in the board examination.
   1. For Diploma to Degree students, the minimum eligibility criteria for availing the benefits of the scheme is a 65% mark at the Diploma level examination from a recognized university situated in the state of Gujarat.
   1. The candidates whose parents annual income is not more than Rs. 6,00,000/- per annum shall only be considered eligible for the said scheme.
   1. The State Government has approved the validity of the income certificate for three financial years from the date of issue. Accordingly, a candidate who has a valid income certificate need not have to issue it again for the next three years financial years.

<br>

<br>

details:

Under the scheme, financial assistance of ₹1,20,000/- is provided to Scheduled Caste individuals who do not own a residential home, have an old rough residential home, or own a plot for residence, and who belong to the Below Poverty Line (BPL) category for the construction of a house. The assistance will be paid in three installments to economically weaker Scheduled Caste individuals, especially those below the poverty line, in both urban and rural areas for house construction on an individual basis.
**Implementing Agency:**
**In Urban Areas**: District Deputy Director, Scheduled Caste Welfare Office
**In Rural Areas:** District Social Welfare Officer Office
benefits_detailed:
1. Under the scheme, individuals belonging to the scheduled caste category are provided with ₹1,20,000/- assistance for the construction of houses in both urban and rural areas.
   1. The assistance will be paid in three instalments, first instalment is ₹40,000/- (with order of administrative sanction), the second instalment is ₹60,000/- (after reaching the lintel level), and the third instalment is ₹20,000/- (On completion of construction, including toilets).
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be a native of Gujarat.
   1. The applicant should belong to the Scheduled Caste category.
   1. Economically weaker Scheduled Caste individuals, especially those below the poverty line are eligible to receive benefits under the scheme.
   1. The beneficiary should not own a residential home, possess an old rough residential home, or have their own plot for residence.
   1. The applicant or any other family members of the applicant should not have already received benefits under any other housing scheme implemented by the Government.
   1. The annual income should not exceed ₹6,00,000/- in rural area and ₹6,00,000/- in urban area.
   1. Those who are eligible for ₹12,000 assistance for toilets will be eligible for it separately as per the rules of the scheme. However, if the beneficiary is not eligible for assistance for a toilet, he/she will have to construct a toilet out which is mandatory for assistance of ₹1,20,000/-.
   1. On the house built under this scheme, the beneficiary will have to put a plaque as per “State Government&#39;s Ambedkar Awas Yojana”.
   1. The upper limit on construction of houses will be ₹10,00,000/- for urban areas and ₹7,00,000/- for rural areas. The ceiling limit will not apply to the assistance provided under the Affordable Housing Scheme in urban areas.
   1. The construction of the house has to be completed within 2 years from the payment of the first installment of the housing assistance.
   1. The age of the beneficiary will be at least 21 years.
   1. A scheduled caste beneficiary can also be given the benefit under this scheme if his adult sons or brother builds a house on the first floor of the person whose name currently has a house on the ground floor to build his own house with the consent of the house owner/landlord. 
   1. If the entire construction of the house cannot be completed with the assistance received under the &quot;Dr. Ambedkar Awas Yojana,&quot; the beneficiary will need to contribute the remaining amount to ensure the completion of the construction of the house.

title: Kaushalya - The Skill University Training
ministry: Government of Gujarat - Department of Skill Development & Employment
benefits: Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
eligibility_summary: Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
details:
**Kaushalya - The Skill University Training** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Gujarat - Department of Skill Development & Employment** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Gujarat.

The scheme was established under the **Skills & Employment** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Free advanced industrial skill training with monthly stipend of ₹3,500 and 100% placement support in local industries.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Gujarat** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **35 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Unemployed youth aged 18 to 35 years who have completed 8th/10th/12th or ITI/Diploma.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Unemployed, Student.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

title: Mukhyamantri Vivah Shagun Yojana
ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details:
Launched in 2021, the scheme "Shagun Yojna" by the Department of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh, aims to provide financial assistance to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families for the marriage of their daughters. Under this scheme, a marriage grant is provided to parents, guardians, or the girl herself if her parents are not alive or traceable. The scheme is implemented by the District Programme Officer through the Child Development Project Officer.
***Objectives:***

- To support BPL families with financial assistance for the marriage of girls above 18 years of age.
- To ensure that eligible girls receive aid even if marrying outside Himachal Pradesh.
benefits_detailed:
- A one-time financial grant of ₹31,000 is provided for the marriage of BPL girls/women.

**NOTE:**

- The grant is given to parents/guardians or the girl herself (if her parents are not alive/traceable).
- The grant can be disbursed up to 2 months before the proposed date of marriage.
- If the marriage has already taken place, the grant may be claimed within 6 months of the marriage date.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The girl applicant must be a bonafide resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The girl must be 18 years of age or above at the time of marriage.
1. The marriage grant will be given even if the girl from Himachal Pradesh is marrying a boy from outside the state of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The family of the applicant girl must be living below the poverty line (BPL). 
1. If the parents of the girl are not alive or traceable, the girl herself can apply.
1. The groom must be above 21 years of age.
1. The applicant should not have availed benefits from Mukhyamantri Kanyadan Yojna or any other similar departmental marriage grant scheme.
1. Those destitute left out women who are not financially able to perform their re-marriage can also apply.

***Application Process:***

The applicant may download the application form [(Annexure "A")](https://himachal.nic.in/showfile.php?lang=1&dpt_id=176&level=1&lid=21273&sublinkid=20943) from the official website.
**Fill and Attach Documents:**
Fill out the form and attach all required documents as listed above.

Submit the completed application to the CDPO/Incharge of Nari Sewa Sadan/Superintendent of Balika Ashram.
**NOTE:**
The application must be submitted within 6 months from the date of marriage to be considered or two months prior to the proposed marriage date. 
**Verification Process:**
The verifying authority checks all details and ensures the applicant has not received similar benefits from other schemes.
**Sanction and Disbursement:**
The District Programme Officer sanctions the grant.
The sanctioned amount is transferred to the CDPO, who disburses it into the applicant’s bank account.
If the application is approved before the marriage, the amount may be disbursed up to two months in advance.

title: Haryana Awas Navinikaran Yojana
ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Housing & Urban Development
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
eligibility_summary: Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.
details:
**Haryana Awas Navinikaran Yojana** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Haryana - Department of Housing & Urban Development** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Haryana.

The scheme was established under the **Housing & Shelter** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Haryana** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **18** and **80 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Unemployed, Self-employed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://saralharyana.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Haryana Awas Navinikaran Yojana?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Haryana - Department of Housing & Urban Development.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.

faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details: The scheme "Old Age Samman Allowance" is a social security scheme implemented by the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Haryana. The scheme provides a pension of ₹3,000/- per month to senior citizens (60 years or above) who are unable to sustain themselves with their own resources. The scheme targets the needy and poorer sections of society, such as agricultural labourers, rural artisans, SCs/BCs, and small/marginal farmers. The scheme is implemented through the Zila Parishads. The pension is disbursed through the Panchayati Raj Institutions.
benefits_detailed: - Pension of ₹3,000/- per month.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant should be 60 years or above in age.
1. The applicant should be domiciled in and a resident of Haryana. 
1. The income of the applicant, from all sources, including that of their spouse, should not exceed ₹3,00,000/- per annum.

title: Haryana Happy Card Free Bus Mobility Scheme
ministry: Government of Haryana - Department of Transport
benefits: Free or 50% subsidized travel for women, students, and seniors in state transport buses, plus EV purchase subsidy.
eligibility_summary: All resident citizens, students, and commuters traveling within state territory.
details:
The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science &amp; Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.
benefits_detailed: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration. - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation. - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per annum is provided for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment. - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for this award. This award will not be available for renewal after completion of 5 years duration.
eligibility_detailed: - Woman scientists/academicians working at permanent position in any Government Institution/R&D Lab/University and willing to resign from their permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and after completion of the tenure return back to the parent organization. - The new place should be located beyond 500 Km from present city. - Upper age limit is 50 years to apply.

Five (5) copies of application should be sent to Department of Science and Technology, Technology Bhawan, New Mehrauli Road, New Delhi-110016 by speed post.

faqs.question: What is the aim of this Scheme?
faqs.answer: The Mobility Scheme is an initiative aimed at providing opportunities to women scientists who face job-related challenges due to relocation.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Women scientists or academicians holding permanent positions in Government Institutions, R&D Labs, or Universities, who are willing to resign or take long leave to avail the fellowship, are eligible.

faqs.question: What circumstances qualify as reasons for relocation under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Qualifying circumstances include relocation due to marriage, transfer of a spouse to another location within the country, attending to ailing parents, or accompanying children studying in a different city.

faqs.question: What is the duration of the fellowship under the Scheme?
faqs.answer: The total tenure of the award is a maximum of five years.

faqs.question: What financial support is provided to the awardees?
faqs.answer: Awardees receive a consolidated monthly salary for the project duration. Additionally, there is a research grant of [?]5 lakh per annum, which includes provisions for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment necessary for implementing the project.

faqs.question: Is there support for hiring manpower under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, the scheme provides need-based support for hiring one manpower personnel to assist in the research project.

faqs.question: Can the awardee return to their parent organization after the fellowship?
faqs.answer: Yes, awardees have the option to return to their parent organization after completing the tenure of the fellowship.

faqs.question: Are there any restrictions on the location of the new workplace?
faqs.answer: Yes, the new workplace must be located more than 500 km away from the applicant's current city.

faqs.question: What is the upper age limit for applicants?

faqs.question: How can one apply for the Mobility Scheme?

benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details:
The Department of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of Himachal Pradesh launched the "Indira Gandhi Pyari Behna Sukh-Samman Nidhi Yojana" scheme. The scheme recognizes the significant contributions of women in household work, cultural preservation, and family economy by providing a monthly assistance**.**
**Objective:** - To honor the contribution of women in the development and preservation of the cultural heritage of the state. - To ensure economic empowerment and self-reliance of women.
benefits_detailed: - **Financial Assistance of ₹1500/- per month.**
eligibility_detailed:
1. The women's age should be between 18-59 years. 
1. The applicant should be a permanent resident of Himachal Pradesh.
1. The applicant's family members do not fall into the following categories: 



  - Central/State Government employees/pensioners, contract/outsourced/daily wage earners/part-time, etc. 
  - Category employees, serving/ex-servicemen and military widows, honorarium receiving Anganwadi workers/helpers/ Asha Workers/Mid-Day Meal Workers, Multi-Task Workers, Social Security Pension Beneficiaries, Employees of Panchayat Raj Institutions/Urban Local Bodies, Pensioners/Pensioners working in various Public Undertakings/Boards/Councils/Agencies under Central/State Government, for Goods and Services Tax Be a registered person and income tax payer etc.
  - Buddhist nuns (Chomo) living permanently in Buddhist monasteries.

faqs.question: What is the monthly amount provided under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligible women receive [?]1500 per month.

faqs.question: What are the key objectives of the scheme?
faqs.answer: To honor women's contribution to cultural heritage and ensure their economic empowerment and self-reliance.

faqs.question: Are Buddhist nuns (chomo) eligible for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Yes, Buddhist nuns living permanently in Buddhist monasteries are eligible.

faqs.question: Who are considered 'family' under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Family includes husband/wife, adult/minor sons, and unmarried daughters registered in the family register or ration card as of 31.03.2023.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized officer for the scheme?
faqs.answer: The Director of Empowerment of Scheduled Castes, Other Backward Classes, Minorities, and Specially Abled, H.P.

faqs.question: How are applications processed?
faqs.answer: Applications are received, sorted, and registered by the Tehsil Welfare Officer before being presented to the competent authority for approval.

faqs.question: What happens to incomplete or ineligible applications?
faqs.answer: They are sent back to the applicant with comments within 15 days.

faqs.question: Who approves the Sukh-Samman Fund?
faqs.answer: The Deputy Commissioner and Resident Commissioner of the respective districts, along with other competent officers.

faqs.question: How is the Sukh-Samman Fund distributed?
faqs.answer: The fund is distributed based on a list compiled by the Tehsil Welfare Officer and verified by competent officers.

faqs.question: How often are beneficiaries inspected?
faqs.answer: District Welfare Officer and Tehsil Welfare Officer inspect 10% and 25% of beneficiaries, respectively, each year.

faqs.question: What is the process for closing the fund for ineligible beneficiaries?
faqs.answer: The fund is permanently closed after obtaining approval from the competent authority and informing the beneficiary.

faqs.question: What happens in case of beneficiary death?
faqs.answer: The fund is closed permanently upon authorized information of the beneficiary's death.

faqs.question: What is the procedure for handling complaints of ineligibility?
faqs.answer: The fund is temporarily stopped and the complaint is investigated by the District or Tehsil Welfare Officer.

faqs.question: What is the head of account for scheme expenditure?
faqs.answer: Expenditure is made from a separate budget head, with top-up on social security pension payable from the related account head.

faqs.question: Who maintains the records related to the scheme?
faqs.answer: The Tehsil Welfare Officer is responsible for maintaining all records related to the scheme.

faqs.question: Who audits the expenditure under the scheme?
faqs.answer: The expenditure is audited by the office of the Accountant General (Accounts), Himachal Pradesh.

title: Ladli Beti Scheme J&K
ministry: Government of Jammu and Kashmir - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
documents: Jammu and Kashmir Domicile / Resident Certificate
details: The "Ladli Beti" scheme is implemented by the Government of the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir through Jammu and Kashmir Bank to provide long-term financial support to eligible girl children. Under the scheme, a recurring deposit account is opened by the natural or legal guardian of the girl child. The Government contributes ₹1,000/- per month for 14 years, subject to the beneficiary's eligibility and approval by the Social Welfare Department. After the recurring deposit matures, it is converted into a cumulative term deposit account. The maturity amount is paid after the beneficiary attains the prescribed age and conditions under the scheme are fulfilled. The scheme is a hybrid deposit plan having two phases: - **Phase I:** A recurring deposit for 14 years having a date of completion as one month after the last installment received in the account.- **Phase II:** A Cumulative Term Deposit (CCR) for 7 years. After the maturity of Phase I (recurring deposit account) the account will graduate to Phase II (Cumulative Term Deposit account). The monthly contribution of ₹1000/- in Phase-I is made by the J&K Govt. The annual income of the parents from all sources should be less than ₹75,000. The required documents are the Application Form, KYC Norms of the Parent/ Guardian, and the sanction letter from the CDPO (Child Development Project Officer).
benefits_detailed:
> **Benefits & Features:**


1. A recurring deposit account under this scheme shall be opened by the natural or legal guardian of the girl child.
1. A contribution of Rs. 1000/- per month will be made by J&K Government from the birth of the girl child/account opening date for the next 14 years.  (A total of Rs. 168000/- only will be contributed by the UT.) 
1. No credits other than a monthly contribution of Rs. 1000/- by the J&K Government is to be allowed in Phase I (RD Account) 
1. After the maturity of Phase I (recurring deposit account) the account will graduate to Phase II (Cumulative Term Deposit account).
1. No partial drawls or Foreclosure will be allowed under any circumstances during any phase. 
1. Maturity benefits under the scheme will be paid to the beneficiary on completion of 21 years of age or 21 years after the first installment or 85 months after the last installment whichever is later by crediting the savings bank account of the girl child. However, the girl child is at liberty to reinvest the amount in any deposit plan of the bank at card rates.
1. The nomination facility will not be applicable in the scheme. In the unfortunate event of the death of the girl child, the account will be closed immediately and the balance amount along with interest accrued will revert to the Union Territories of J&K and Ladakh;
1. In the event of the death of the beneficiary, before she attains 21 years of age, the amount in the Recurring Deposit account / Term Deposit account shall be closed before maturity without pre-payment charges.
1. The account opened at a particular branch may not be transferred to any other branch even if the girl child in whose name the account stands shifts to a place other than the city or locality where the account stands.
1. The beneficiary/parent or guardian of the beneficiary shall produce a ‘life certificate of the beneficiary (girl child)’ certified by a gazetted officer or by the principal of the school/ college where she is enrolled before the concerned bank branch after every three years and at the time of maturity.
1. As the scheme is aimed at households having an annual income of less than 75000/- The TDS shall not be deducted as long as the guardian/beneficiary furnishes form 15G/15H every year and has a valid PAN
eligibility_detailed: - The girl child should have been born on or after 01/04/2015. - The annual income of the parents of the girl child from all sources should be less than ₹75,000. - The girl child and her family should be residents of Jammu & Kashmir.

The scheme was established under the **Social Welfare & Empowerment** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Jammu and Kashmir** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **60** and **100 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Female** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Retired, Unemployed.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

title: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana
ministry: Government of Jharkhand - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct financial support of ₹10,000 per year for procurement of quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment inputs.
eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers holding verified land records in the state.
details: There are many members of the economically disadvantaged part of society who are unable to plan their daughters’ weddings owing to their precarious financial situation. And they deal with several issues relating to this. The Punjab Ashirwad plan has been introduced by the Punjab government by keeping such a situation in mind. Girls from economically disadvantaged parts of society will get financial aid under this program. so that they won’t have to worry about any financial obligations when planning their daughter’s wedding. The scheme aims not only to help girls but also to encourage such families who are raising girls and want to marry them.
benefits_detailed: - Financial assistance of ₹51,000/-.
eligibility_detailed:
1. Girl should be 18 years old or above.
   1. Annual income of the family from all sources does not exceed ₹32,790/-.
   1. Parents/Guardians of the girl should be domiciled in Punjab State.
   1. The application can be given before the fixed date of marriage or after the 30 days of the marriage by the applicant for getting financial assistance.
   1. The amount of Ashirwad is limited up to two girls of the concerned family under the scheme.
   1. Financial assistance is given to Scheduled Castes/Christian girls, Backward Classes/Castes, Economically weaker sections girls, daughters of widows of any caste at the time of their marriage, and Scheduled Castes widows/divorcees at the time of their re-marriage.

benefits: Full tuition reimbursement, annual book grant of ₹15,000, and free competitive exam coaching for merit students.
eligibility_summary: Students belonging to economically weaker families pursuing secondary or higher education.
details: The Guruji Student Credit Card (GSCC) Scheme was launched by the Department of Higher and Technical Education, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide financial support to students pursue higher education without financial constraints. Under this scheme, eligible students can avail education loans up to ₹15 lakhs at a subsidized 4% simple interest rate, with additional benefits for female students.
benefits_detailed: 1. Education loans up to ₹15,00,000/- at a subsidized 4% interest rate. 1. Long Repayment Term: Maximum repayment tenure of up to 15 years. 1. No Processing Fees: No additional fees for loan processing, sanctioning, or disbursement.
eligibility_detailed: 1. The applicant should be a student. 1. The student should be an Indian national. 1. The student should have completed class 10th to pursue a diploma and class 10th and 12th to pursue undergraduate or higher courses from a recognized school in Jharkhand. 1. The student should have secured admission in institutions like IITs, IIMs, IIESTs, ISIs, NLUs, AIIMSs, NITs, XLRI, IISCs, BITS, SPA, NID, IIFTs, ICFAI Business School etc within and outside of the state (within India) which are ranked up to 200 in the overall list or ranked up to 100 in their respective individual category of NIRF Rankings or have been accredited grade either “A" or above by NAAC. 1. The student should not be aged more than 40 (forty) years at the time of application for loan. 1. The student should not be a prior beneficiary of the scheme. 1. The student should not have availed education loan from any State Co-operative Banks, Central Co-operative Banks, District Central Co-operative Banks, or any Public or Private sector Banks for the course in which he/she is applying for a loan under the Scheme.

faqs.question: What is the Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme?
faqs.answer: The scheme provides financial support for Jharkhand students to pursue higher education with education loans up to [?]15,00,000/- at a subsidized 4% interest rate.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Students who completed their 10th and 12th grades in Jharkhand and secured admission to recognized institutions for diploma, undergraduate, or higher courses are eligible.

faqs.question: Is there an age limit for applying?
faqs.answer: Yes, applicants must be 40 years or younger at the time of application.

faqs.question: Which courses are covered under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Courses such as engineering, medical, law, and research at reputed institutions like IITs, IIMs, and AIIMS are covered.

faqs.question: What is the maximum loan amount I can get?
faqs.answer: Students can avail up to [?]15,00,000/- as an education loan.

faqs.question: How is the interest rate calculated?
faqs.answer: A 4% simple interest rate applies, and an additional 0.5% reduction is available for female students.

faqs.question: Are collateral or guarantees required?
faqs.answer: No collateral is required; however, a co-obligation from parents or legal guardians is necessary.

faqs.question: How can I apply for the scheme?
faqs.answer: Register on the GSCC web portal, fill out the application form, and submit necessary documents like admission letters and fee schedules.

faqs.question: Can I choose any bank for the loan?
faqs.answer: You must select a Member Lending Institution (MLI) from the onboarded banks listed on the portal.

faqs.question: What expenses does the loan cover?
faqs.answer: The loan covers institutional fees, hostel expenses, and a portion for non-institutional costs like travel, rent, and study materials.

faqs.question: How much of the loan can be used for non-institutional expenses?
faqs.answer: Up to 30% of the loan can be allocated for non-institutional expenses.

faqs.question: What happens if I don’t use the non-institutional advance?
faqs.answer: Any unused amount can be rolled over to the next semester.

faqs.question: Is there a moratorium period for repayment?
faqs.answer: Yes, there's a one-year repayment holiday after course completion or employment, whichever is earlier.

faqs.question: What if I can’t repay the loan on time?
faqs.answer: Loans not repaid in time may invoke the Public Demand Recovery Act after notifying the student.

faqs.question: How is the loan disbursed to institutions?
faqs.answer: Institutional fees are directly paid to the institution's bank account as per the payment schedule.

faqs.question: Is there a processing fee for the loan?
faqs.answer: No processing fees are charged by the lending bank for sanctioning or disbursement.

faqs.question: What documentation is required?
faqs.answer: Documents like admission letters, academic records, Aadhaar, and parent/legal guardian's co-obligation are needed.

faqs.question: Is insurance required for this loan?
faqs.answer: Yes, students must have life insurance up to the loan amount, with premiums debited from the loan account.

faqs.question: How can I track my loan status?
faqs.answer: Students can monitor their application, disbursement, and repayment status on their personal dashboard on the GSCC web portal.

faqs.question: Who can I contact for support?
faqs.answer: A dedicated helpline by the Web Portal Development Agency is available for scheme-related and technical queries.

title: Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar
ministry: Government of Jharkhand - Department of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
eligibility_summary: All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
details:
**Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Jharkhand - Department of Health & Family Welfare** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Jharkhand.

The scheme was established under the **Health & Wellness** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Jharkhand** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Standard adult Indian citizen age guidelines apply.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Self-employed, Unemployed, Homemaker, Retired.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Mukhyamantri Gambhir Bimari Upchar?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of Jharkhand - Department of Health & Family Welfare.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required to apply?
faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.question: How are the benefits or funds disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://jharsewa.jharkhand.gov.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

title: Abua Awas Yojana
ministry: Government of Jharkhand - Department of Housing & Urban Development
benefits: Financial grant of ₹1.50 lakh for construction of disaster-resilient pucca house with free sanitation connection.
eligibility_summary: Houseless families or those residing in kutcha thatched dwellings holding state domicile.
details: The "Abua Awas Yojana" was launched by the Department of Rural Development, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide pucca houses to 8,00,000 homeless families in three phases with a budget of ₹16,320/- crore, prioritizes housing for vulnerable and underprivileged families, providing financial and labor assistance for construction. Each house will feature three rooms and a kitchen, covering an area of 31 square meters.
benefits_detailed:
- Financial assistance of ₹2,00,000/- per beneficiary for house construction.
- Provision for 95 days of unskilled labor wages under MGNREGA.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The families living in kutcha houses or without permanent housing.
1. The specially vulnerable tribal groups (PVTG), victims of natural calamities, and released bonded laborers are eligible for this scheme.
1. The family should not be benefited from existing housing schemes like PMAY-R, Indira Awas Yojana, or Birsa Awas Yojana.

title: Jharkhand Sarvajan Pension Yojana

benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details: The "Sarvajan Pension Yojana" was launched by the Department of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Government of Jharkhand. The scheme aims to provide financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month to elderly individuals, widows, destitute women, differently-abled persons, primitive tribes, and HIV/AIDS patients. The scheme eliminates previous age restrictions and targets inclusivity by guaranteeing pensions to all eligible citizens above the age of 60.
benefits_detailed:
- **A pension of ₹1,000/- per month.**
> Note: Timely pension disbursal by the 5th of every month.
eligibility_detailed:
1. The applicant must be a resident of Jharkhand.
1. The applicants should be elderly, widows, destitute women, differently-abled, primitive tribes and people suffering from HIV/AIDS. 
1. The senior citizen's age should be 60 years or above.
1. The destitute women's age should be 18 years or above 
1. The differently-abled age should be 5 years or above.

eligibility_summary: Budding entrepreneurs and artisans seeking to launch new manufacturing or service units.
details: There are many members of the economically disadvantaged part of society who are unable to plan their daughters’ weddings owing to their precarious financial situation. And they deal with several issues relating to this. The Punjab Ashirwad plan has been introduced by the Punjab government by keeping such a situation in mind. Girls from economically disadvantaged parts of society will get financial aid under this program. so that they won’t have to worry about any financial obligations when planning their daughter’s wedding. The scheme aims not only to help girls but also to encourage such families who are raising girls and want to marry them.
benefits_detailed: - Financial assistance of ₹51,000/-.
eligibility_detailed:
1. Girl should be 18 years old or above.
   1. Annual income of the family from all sources does not exceed ₹32,790/-.
   1. Parents/Guardians of the girl should be domiciled in Punjab State.
   1. The application can be given before the fixed date of marriage or after the 30 days of the marriage by the applicant for getting financial assistance.
   1. The amount of Ashirwad is limited up to two girls of the concerned family under the scheme.
   1. Financial assistance is given to Scheduled Castes/Christian girls, Backward Classes/Castes, Economically weaker sections girls, daughters of widows of any caste at the time of their marriage, and Scheduled Castes widows/divorcees at the time of their re-marriage.

details:

faqs.question: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
faqs.answer: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

faqs.question: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
faqs.answer: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

faqs.question: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
faqs.answer: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
faqs.answer: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: No, as per the guidelines, there is no fee required for the registration.

faqs.question: How to enroll as a beneficiary under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: Applicants can visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to enroll themselves as a beneficiary under the board: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
faqs.answer: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
faqs.answer: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

faqs.question: Why is it important to inform the Board about the death of a pensioner?
faqs.answer: Informing the Board about the death of a pensioner is important to ensure that the pension payments are stopped, and the pensioner's bank account is properly closed, preventing any unauthorized transactions.

faqs.question: What documents are required to notify the Board about the death of a pensioner?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs need to provide the death certificate of the pensioner to the BOCW Welfare Board.

faqs.answer: Applicants should visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to avail the assistance under this scheme: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

title: Snehasparsham & She-Pad Scheme
ministry: Government of Kerala - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details:
The Government of Kerala has launched the “Snehasparsham” scheme to protect and help unwed mothers. The problems of unwed mothers are linked with various socio-economic and cultural variables. In Kerala, this problem is coupled with the ignorance and exploitation of the backward classes. It has been pointed out that there are many women in Wayanad and other districts of Kerala who are victims of social exploitation and atrocities and are often forced to become unmarried mothers. Unwed mothers have a special need for education, employment, and health care especially reproductive and child health. Quite often they are neglected from the mainstream of life. The percentage of abortion-related hazards and death is high among teenage unwed mothers.
             As a part of this scheme, the Government is giving ₹1000/- per month to them. One curious fact that can be noted is that the women who are exploited never blame the person who caused their misery, largely due to their style of living. title: Aaswasakiranam Caregiver Pension
ministry: Government of Kerala - Department of Social Welfare
benefits: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_summary: Resident senior citizens aged 60+, widows, and disabled citizens without family support.
details:
**Detailed** 
Kerala is a state well known for its efficient and effective health care system. Despite these advancements, much headway could not be made in-home care. Most of the lowest income group always opt for homely treatment as they cannot afford the charges levied by the well-known hospitals. They are bedridden causing a heavy social burden on their family members who are forced to stay back at home to look after these bedridden patients. While the upper-income group can possibly afford to engage paid caregivers or home nurses for looking after such bedridden family members, the lower-income group usually take it upon themselves to care for their bedridden brethren. These family members in fact function as informal caregivers, without due recognition or economic gain.
<br>

**Coverage Of Diseases** 
●	All bed-ridden patients who need a full-time caregiver.
●	Mentally challenged (Autism, Cerebral Palsy, Mental retardation, Mental illness).
●	100 % blind, bed-ridden cancer patients, old-aged bed-ridden.
●	Brittle bone disease.
benefits_detailed: Monthly financial pension of ₹1,500 to ₹2,500 directly paid to senior citizens, widows, and persons with disabilities.
eligibility_detailed:
**Eligibility** 

1. One who is totally bedridden and at home with a debilitating disability (physical, functional or mental).
1. One can not take care of himself/herself for any day-to-day activity without the support of another person.
1. One who belongs to a family, Below Poverty Line as per the BPL list and as per the ration card.

faqs.answer: The scheme provides financial assistance of [?]1,20,000/-, which is disbursed in three installments of [?]40,000 each.

faqs.answer: After submission, the documents are verified, and a field inspection may be conducted to assess the condition of the existing house. Upon approval, the funds are disbursed in installments.

faqs.answer: No, the Mukhyamantri Gramin Awas Yojana is specifically designed for rural areas.

faqs.answer: The scheme is applicable to houses constructed under cluster housing schemes initiated before January 1996.

title: MP Atal City Bus Mobility Scheme
ministry: Government of Madhya Pradesh - Department of Transport
benefits: Free or 50% subsidized travel for women, students, and seniors in state transport buses, plus EV purchase subsidy.
eligibility_summary: All resident citizens, students, and commuters traveling within state territory.
details:
The “Mobility Scheme” was launched under Knowledge Involvement in Research Advancement through Nurturing (KIRAN) Programme by the Department of Science &amp; Technology, Government of India, aims to address relocation issue of women scientists working in regular position in Government Organizations. The scheme aims to provide an opportunity to women scientists who are facing difficulties in their present job due to relocation (marriage, transfer of husband to any other location within the country, attending ailing parents, and accompanying children studying in different city) and will act as filler while searching other career option at new place.
The initiative intends to provide a harmonious environment during early phases of women scientists where they would like to stay active in research in addition to attending and fulfilling other responsibilities in the domestic front. It offers a contractual research award to women scientists and enables them for independent research.
benefits_detailed: - **Monthly Salary:** Consolidated monthly salary is provided to awardees for the entire project duration. - **Manpower Support:** Need-based manpower support is provided to assist in project implementation. - **Research Grant:** ₹5,00,000/- per annum is provided for consumables, contingencies, travel, and minor equipment. - ***Duration:*** Total tenure will be a maximum of five (5) years for this award. This award will not be available for renewal after completion of 5 years duration.
eligibility_detailed: - Woman scientists/academicians working at permanent position in any Government Institution/R&D Lab/University and willing to resign from their permanent position or take a long leave to avail the fellowship and after completion of the tenure return back to the parent organization. - The new place should be located beyond 500 Km from present city. - Upper age limit is 50 years to apply.

children.text: The applicant needs to prepare a full-fledged research proposal in the area of her expertise.
Five copies of application form including general information and research proposal is to be submitted in prescribed format available at

title: Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya (MJPJAY)
ministry: Government of Maharashtra - Department of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
eligibility_summary: All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
details:
The Mahatma Jyotirao Phule Jan Arogya Yojana (MJPJAY), launched by the Government of Maharashtra under  Public Health and Family Welfare Department,The scheme provides cashless medical services for secondary and tertiary treatments through empaneled hospitals. Initially targeted at low-income families, the scheme now covers all families in the state, offering up to ₹1.5 lakh under MJPJAY and ₹5 lakh under Ayushman Bharat annually. From 1st July 2024, it ensures comprehensive, cashless healthcare for the entire population of Maharashtra.
<br>
benefits_detailed:
- **Health Coverage for Categories A to E (Excluding D):** ₹5 lakhs per family per year on a floater basis under both schemes.- **Health Coverage for Category D:** ₹1 lakh per person per year.
**Medical Benefits** • For categories A to E (Excluding D) - 1356 Health Benefits Packages under 34 specialities. • For category D – 184 Health Benefits Packages for Road accident patients. **Follow-up treatment** - 262 Health Benefits Packages for both schemes (for categories A to E) **Treatment Reserved for Govt. Hospitals** - 119 Health Benefits Packages for both the schemes (for categories A to E) **Benefits under Health Packages** The health packages provide comprehensive coverage, ensuring a cashless treatment experience for patients. The benefits include: **Hospitalization Costs** - Bed charges in general wards. - Nursing and boarding charges. - Surgeons, anaesthetists, medical practitioners, and consultants' fees. **Medical Expenses** - Charges for oxygen, O.T., and ICU facilities. - Cost of surgical appliances, drugs, disposables, consumables, implants, and prosthetic devices. - Expenses for blood transfusion (as per State Government policy). **Diagnostics and Support Services** - X-rays and diagnostic tests. - Food for inpatients during hospitalization. **Transportation Costs** - One-time transport cost by State Transport or second-class rail fare from the hospital to the patient’s residence. - In the unfortunate event of a patient's death, the cost of transporting the deceased's body from the network hospital to their village or township. - The package covers all costs from the date of reporting to discharge, including treatment complications, ensuring a truly cashless experience for patients.
**Scheme on Assurance Mode** The Integrated Scheme is being implemented on an Assurance Basis. This means that the claims of the network hospitals for the expenses of the patients undergoing treatment under the scheme are being paid directly by the State Health Assurance Societies to the respective network hospitals. Accordingly, the State Health Assurance Society is paying claims up to ₹5 lakh per family per year of groups A, B, C and E and ₹1 lakh per person per year for road accident victims of group D.
eligibility_detailed:
**Category A:** Families holding Yellow, Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY), Annapurna Yojna and Orange Ration Card.
**Category B**	
• White ration card holder families (including Govt./Semi Gov employees).
• A family without having any kind of ration card but having domicile certificate of Maharashtra
**Category C**	
• Students in Govt. and Govt. recognized Ashram School
• Children in Govt. and Govt. recognized Orphanages
• Women in Govt. and Govt. recognized Women's Ashram
• Sr. citizens in Govt. and Govt. recognized old age homes
• Journalists and their dependent family members as per criteria of Directorate General of Information and Public Relations Office.
• Construction workers and their families (who are resident of outside of Maharashtra) registered with Maharashtra Building and Other Construction Workers Board.
**Category D**	

- Road traffic accident victims from outside Maharashtra and outside India who met with an accident on roads in Maharashtra

**Category E**
Families holding below mentioned ration cards from 865 villages of Belgaon, Karwar, Kalburgi and Bidar Districts of Maharashtra- Karnataka border
1) Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY)
2) Priority House Holder (PHH)
3) Annapurna Yojna
