faqs.question: What is the annual family income limit for a DNT student to be eligible for benefits under the scheme?
faqs.answer: Only DNT students having a total family income from all sources of ₹2,50,000 or less per annum are eligible.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility condition for students applying for coaching for Class 12th level competitive exams?
faqs.answer: For competitive exams where the qualifying exam is Class 12th, benefits are available only if the candidate has passed Class 12th or is studying in Class 12th as on the date of receiving the benefit.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility condition for students seeking coaching for bachelor-level competitive exams?
faqs.answer: Only students/candidates who have completed their bachelor's level course or are studying in the final year of the bachelor's degree course at the time of receiving benefits are eligible.

faqs.question: How many students will the Development and Welfare Board for De-Notified, Nomadic and Semi-Nomadic Communities (DWBDNC) select each year?
faqs.answer: The DWBDNC will select a total of 1,250 students each year.

faqs.question: What is the distribution of slots for coaching based on the qualifying examination level?
faqs.answer: 60% of the total available slots are allotted to courses where the qualifying exam is graduation (Bachelor’s level), and 40% are for courses where the qualifying exam is Class 12.

faqs.question: What is the process for submitting applications for the Free Coaching Scheme?
faqs.answer: Applicants are required to apply online on the [department's portal](https://dwbdnc.dosje.gov.in/), along with details of the course they intend to join.

faqs.question: When does the online application portal for the scheme remain open for receiving applications?
faqs.answer: The portal remains open for one month, twice a year, specifically during the months of July and January, for receiving applications.

title: UP Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh - Department of Health & Family Welfare
benefits: Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
eligibility_summary: All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
details:
**UP Mukhyamantri Jan Arogya Yojana** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of Uttar Pradesh - Department of Health & Family Welfare** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across Uttar Pradesh.

The scheme was established under the **Health & Wellness** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Cashless secondary and tertiary medical treatments up to ₹5 lakh per family per year in empannelled hospitals.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
eligibility_detailed:
### Eligibility Requirements

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **Uttar Pradesh** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Standard adult Indian citizen age guidelines apply.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** All low and middle income resident families holding state ration card or family ID.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Farmer, Self-employed, Unemployed, Homemaker, Retired.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

title: Mukhyamantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana
ministry: Government of Uttar Pradesh - Department of Women & Child Development
benefits: Monthly direct bank transfer of ₹1,200 to ₹1,500 to women heads of family to ensure dignity and financial self-reliance.
eligibility_summary: Adult women residents aged 18 to 60 years belonging to low-income households.
details:
Women empowerment is the commitment of the state government. In view of the above, it has been decided by the state government to implement the &quot;Kanya Sumangala Yojana&quot;. 
The main objective of Kanya Sumangala Yojana is to end female feticide, establish an equal gender ratio, stop the malpractice of child marriage, and improve the health of girls. And to encourage education, help in making girls self-reliant, to develop positive thinking in the society towards the birth of a girl child.&quot;
benefits_detailed: Kanya Sumangala Yojana will be applicable in six categories. The categories of beneficiary classification and distribution of funds for them are determined as follows:- First PhaseAt the birth of a girl child.Rs. 2,000/- lump sumSecond PhaseAfter complete vaccination of the girl child up to one year. Rs. 1,000/- lump sumThird PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in first classRs. 2,000/- lump sumFourth PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in class VIRs. 2,000/- lump sumFifth PhaseAfter the admission of girl child in class IXRs. 3,000/- lump sumSixth PhaseSuch girls who have passed class 12th and have taken admission in graduation or diploma courses of 02 years or more duration.Rs. 5,000/- lump sum
eligibility_detailed:
1. The beneficiary&#39;s family should be a resident of Uttar Pradesh and have a permanent residence certificate, in which Ration Card / Aadhaar Card / Voter ID Card / Electricity / Telephone bill will be valid.
   1. The maximum annual family income of the beneficiary should be ₹3,00,000/-.
   1. Maximum of two girls in a family will be able to get the benefit of the scheme.
   1. There should be a maximum of two children in the family.
   1. If a woman has twins from the second delivery, the benefit will also be admissible to the girl child as the third child. If a woman has a girl child from the first delivery and only two twin girls from the second delivery, then only in such a situation the benefit will be admissible to all three girls.

faqs.question: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
faqs.answer: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

faqs.question: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
faqs.answer: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

faqs.question: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
faqs.answer: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
faqs.answer: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: No, as per the guidelines, there is no fee required for the registration.

faqs.question: How to enroll as a beneficiary under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
faqs.answer: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
faqs.answer: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

faqs.question: Why is it important to inform the Board about the death of a pensioner?
faqs.answer: Informing the Board about the death of a pensioner is important to ensure that the pension payments are stopped, and the pensioner's bank account is properly closed, preventing any unauthorized transactions.

faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs need to provide the death certificate of the pensioner to the BOCW Welfare Board.

title: Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana
ministry: Government of Uttarakhand - Department of Energy & Water Resources
benefits: Free 150-200 units domestic electricity or up to 50% state top-up subsidy on domestic solar rooftop plants.
eligibility_summary: Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.
details: The scheme “Mukhyamantri Saur Swarojgar Yojana” is implemented by the Uttarakhand Renewable Energy Development Agency (UREDA) under the Department of Energy, Government of Uttarakhand. The scheme aims to promote self-employment among the residents of Uttarakhand by enabling them to establish and operate solar power projects, thereby generating clean energy, providing a sustainable source of income, and encouraging entrepreneurship.
benefits_detailed: Under the scheme, self-employment is provided to eligible applicants/beneficiaries through the allocation of solar power projects with capacities of 20, 25, 50, 100, and 200 kW, as detailed below: - 20 kW: Project cost ₹10 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters. - 25 kW: Project cost ₹12.50 lakh; land required – 300 sq. meters. - 50 kW: Project cost ₹25.00 lakh; land required – 700–1000 sq. meters. - 100 kW: Project cost ₹50.00 lakh; land required – 1500–2000 sq. meters. - 200 kW: Project cost ₹100.00 lakh; land required – 3000–4000 sq. meters. ***(Selected candidates will be provided loans from Uttarakhand State/District Cooperative Banks at an interest rate of 8%. Additionally, beneficiaries will be eligible for incentives and benefits under the MSME Policy-2023, provided by the Industries Department.)*** The electricity generated from the allotted solar projects will be purchased by Uttarakhand Power Corporation Limited (UPCL) for a period of 25 years. Payments to beneficiaries will be made according to the prevailing tariff rates for the electricity sold.

To avail benefits under the current MSME Policy, the allottee must apply under this scheme as a proprietorship. Applications in the form of a partnership firm, company, trust, or society will not be permitted.

title: Krishak Bandhu Scheme
ministry: Government of West Bengal - Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefits: Direct financial support of ₹10,000 per year for procurement of quality seeds, fertilizers, and farm equipment inputs.
eligibility_summary: Small and marginal farmers holding verified land records in the state.
details: Launched in 2019, the scheme &quot;Krishak Bandhu Scheme&quot; by the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal, aims to provide financial assistance to farmers for agricultural sustainability and risk mitigation. The scheme offers ₹5,000/- per acre per year as direct income support and ₹2,00,000/- as death benefit to the family of deceased farmers. Eligible beneficiaries include small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 acres of land and all farmer families in case of death or disability. The scheme is implemented by the Department of Agriculture, Government of West Bengal, and applications are accepted both online and offline.
benefits_detailed:
**Direct Income Support**

  - Farmers with one acre or more of cultivable land receive ₹10,000/- per annum, payable in two equal installments of ₹5,000/- each (one for Kharif and one for Rabi season).
  - Farmers with less than one acre of cultivable land receive assistance on a pro-rata basis, subject to a minimum of ₹4,000/- per annum, paid in two equal installments.

**Death/Disability Benefit**

  - In the event of the death of a farmer between the ages of 18 and 60 years, a one-time lump sum grant of ₹2,00,000/- is provided to the legal heirs of the deceased. The farmer must have been enrolled under the Krishak Bandhu scheme at the time of death.


  - A one-time lump sum grant of ₹2,00,000/- for permanent disability of the farmer due to accident.

**Disbursement Conditions**

  - Income support is linked to land ownership records.
  - Death benefit requires submission of legal heir certificates.
  - Disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to the beneficiary&amp;#39;s bank account.
eligibility_detailed:
**For Income Support**

  - The applicant must be a resident of West Bengal.
  - The applicant must own cultivable land (up to 2 acres).
  - The applicant must be actively engaged in farming.

**For Death/Disability Benefit**

  - The deceased/disabled person must have been a farmer aged 18–60 years.
  - The applicant must be the legal heir (for death benefit).

faqs.answer: Eligible farmers receive ₹5,000/- per acre per year, with a maximum limit of 2 acres.

faqs.answer: The deceased must have been a farmer aged between 18–60 years, and the claimant must be the legal heir.

faqs.answer: Only farmers between 18–60 years of age are covered under the death and disability benefits.

faqs.answer: You need an Aadhaar card (linked to a bank account), land ownership proof, and a bank passbook copy.

faqs.answer: A Record of Rights (RoR) or Pattadar Passbook serves as valid land ownership proof.

faqs.question: Who can register as a beneficiary under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of Karnataka?
faqs.answer: Any construction worker whose age is minimum 18 years of age and has worked in any construction work for a minimum of 90 days in a year, are eligible to register as a beneficiary under the Board.

faqs.question: Is there a minimum service requirement to register as a beneficiary?
faqs.answer: Yes, the building worker must have completed 90 days of service as a building worker in the preceding 12 months.

faqs.question: Who can apply for the welfare scheme?
faqs.answer: Any registered worker of the Board can apply for the welfare scheme.

faqs.question: What are the mandatory documents for the registration?
faqs.answer: The documents required for registration are: Employment Certificate (Form V(A)/V(B)/V(C)/V(D)), Aadhar Card (Self-Attested), Ration Card(non-mandatory), Age Proof (one of them Example: Voter ID Card, Aadhar Card).

faqs.question: How often must a construction worker renew their registration with the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: A construction worker must renew their registration every 3 years.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period?
faqs.answer: If a worker doesn't renew their registration within the 3-year period, they are granted a 1-year grace period to complete the renewal.

faqs.question: What happens if a worker doesn't renew their registration during the grace period?
faqs.answer: If the worker fails to renew their registration during the 1-year grace period, their registration will become invalid.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required for the registration under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: No, as per the guidelines, there is no fee required for the registration.

faqs.question: How to enroll as a beneficiary under the Karnataka Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board?
faqs.answer: Applicants can visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to enroll themselves as a beneficiary under the board: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

faqs.question: What are the eligibility criteria for this pension scheme?
faqs.answer: To be eligible, a worker must be a registered beneficiary of the BOCW Welfare Board, must have completed 60 years of age, must have been a beneficiary of the Board for at least 3 years prior to reaching 60, and must not be receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: How much pension can a beneficiary receive under this scheme?
faqs.answer: A beneficiary can receive a pension of up to [?]3,000 per month under this scheme.

faqs.question: Can a beneficiary receive this pension if they are already getting a pension from another government scheme?
faqs.answer: No, a beneficiary cannot receive this pension if they are already receiving similar benefits from other government schemes.

faqs.question: What should the legal dependents or heirs do if a pensioner passes away?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs must inform the BOCW Welfare Board as soon as possible about the death of the pensioner and submit the death certificate to initiate the process of closing the pensioner's bank account.

faqs.question: Why is it important to inform the Board about the death of a pensioner?
faqs.answer: Informing the Board about the death of a pensioner is important to ensure that the pension payments are stopped, and the pensioner's bank account is properly closed, preventing any unauthorized transactions.

faqs.question: What documents are required to notify the Board about the death of a pensioner?
faqs.answer: The legal dependents or heirs need to provide the death certificate of the pensioner to the BOCW Welfare Board.

faqs.question: How to apply for the assistance under this scheme?
faqs.answer: Applicants should visit the official Website of Karnataka Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB) to avail the assistance under this scheme: https://kbocwwb.karnataka.gov.in/login

1. **Residency & Domicile:** The applicant must be a citizen of India and a bona fide permanent resident of **West Bengal** with valid domicile documentation.
2. **Age Bracket:** Age between **5** and **100 years** at the time of application.
3. **Target Beneficiary Profile:** All resident citizens, students, and commuters traveling within state territory.
4. **Gender Eligibility:** Open to **Male, Female, Transgender** applicants.
5. **Income Criterion:** Eligible income categories include: Below ₹1,00,000 per annum, ₹1,00,000 to ₹2,50,000 per annum, ₹2,50,000 to ₹5,00,000 per annum, ₹5,00,000 to ₹8,00,000 per annum.
6. **Social Categories:** GENERAL, SC, ST, OBC communities.
7. **Applicable Occupations:** Student, Farmer, Self-employed, Unemployed, Homemaker, Retired.
8. **Geographical Coverage:** Beneficiaries residing in Urban and Rural areas.

> **Exclusion Criteria:** Individuals already drawing duplicate central/state pensions under identical heads, or taxpayers filing annual income above designated threshold brackets may be disqualified as per official guidelines.

steps.title: Access Official Portal
steps.description: Navigate to the official scheme portal at https://wb.gov.in/ or the state single-window citizen welfare portal.

steps.title: Citizen Registration & Aadhaar e-KYC
steps.description: Click on 'Apply Online / New Registration', provide your active mobile number, and complete Aadhaar OTP verification.

steps.title: Complete Application Form
steps.description: Fill in your demographic profile, family details, bank account credentials (IFSC code, Account number), and select 'Kolkata Green Transport Subsidy Scheme'.

steps.title: Upload Required Documents
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of required documents (Aadhaar, income certificate, bank passbook) in PDF/JPEG format (typically under 2MB).

steps.title: Submit & Save Acknowledgement
steps.description: Review your submitted information, click Final Submit, and save or print the Application Acknowledgement Number for tracking.

steps.title: Obtain Application Form
steps.description: Collect the official application form free of cost from the nearest Gram Panchayat office, Block Development Office (BDO), Municipal Ward office, or Common Service Centre (CSC).

steps.title: Attach Self-Attested Documents
steps.description: Fill the form in legible handwriting and attach self-attested photocopies of Aadhaar, bank passbook, domicile, and passport size photographs.

steps.title: Submit & Collect Receipt
steps.description: Submit the completed application dossier to the designated Nodal Officer or CSC desk and obtain a dated, stamped acknowledgment receipt.

faqs.question: What is the primary objective of Kolkata Green Transport Subsidy Scheme?
faqs.answer: The primary objective is to provide structured financial support, social security, and welfare assistance to eligible beneficiaries under the supervision of Government of West Bengal - Department of Transport.

faqs.question: Who is eligible to apply for this scheme?
faqs.answer: Eligibility is determined by age, residency, income bracket, and category. In brief: All resident citizens, students, and commuters traveling within state territory.

faqs.question: Is there any application fee required to apply?
faqs.answer: No, the Government does not charge any application or registration fee for this welfare scheme. Citizens are cautioned against paying any unauthorized agents or intermediaries.

faqs.question: How are the benefits or funds disbursed to the beneficiary?
faqs.answer: All financial benefits are disbursed via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) directly into the applicant's bank account linked with Aadhaar, eliminating middlemen and ensuring prompt delivery.

faqs.question: Where can I track my submitted application status?
faqs.answer: You can track application status online using your application acknowledgment number on the official portal (https://wb.gov.in/) or by visiting your local Block Development / CSC office.

title: West Bengal Hasir Rekha Free Electricity
ministry: Government of West Bengal - Department of Energy & Water Resources
benefits: Free 150-200 units domestic electricity or up to 50% state top-up subsidy on domestic solar rooftop plants.
eligibility_summary: Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state.
details:
**West Bengal Hasir Rekha Free Electricity** is an official flagship initiative administered by the **Government of West Bengal - Department of Energy & Water Resources** aimed at uplifting eligible citizens across West Bengal.

The scheme was established under the **Utility & Sanitation** portfolio to provide direct financial assistance, socio-economic empowerment, and institutional welfare support to target beneficiaries. Eligible applicants are facilitated with direct benefit transfers (DBT), subsidy components, or protective social security benefits following transparent verification guidelines established by the government.

Under current operating directives, the scheme serves to enhance accessibility for Domestic residential power consumers possessing valid electricity meter connection in the state. and ensures equitable distribution of government assistance through digital and transparent public service delivery channels.
benefits_detailed:
### Key Benefits & Entitlements

* **Core Financial / Welfare Support:** Free 150-200 units domestic electricity or up to 50% state top-up subsidy on domestic solar rooftop plants.
* **Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT):** Financial assistance and subsidies are deposited directly into the beneficiary's Aadhaar-linked bank account (BSBDA / Jan Dhan compatible).
* **Institutional Safeguards:** Complete waiver of hidden processing charges or intermediary fees; state/central monitoring ensures timely disbursement.
* **Complementary Services:** Eligible beneficiaries may also access associated capacity-building, health cover, or subsidized credit support under allied government programs.
